import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {
  CreateExaminationDto,
  UpdateExaminationDto,
  GradingSystem,
} from './dto/create-examination.dto';
import {
  EnterGradeDto,
  BulkEnterGradesDto,
  UpdateGradeDto,
  QueryGradesDto,
  CompetencyLevel,
} from './dto/marks-entry.dto';
import {
  GenerateReportCardDto,
  BulkGenerateReportCardsDto,
  UpdateReportCardDto,
  ApproveReportCardDto,
  QueryReportCardsDto,
  ReportCardStatus,
} from './dto/report-card.dto';

@Injectable()
export class ExaminationsService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExaminationsService.name);

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== EXAMINATIONS ====================

  async createExamination(dto: CreateExaminationDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate term exists
    const term = await this.prisma.term.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.termId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!term) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Term not found');
    }

    // Validate class exists
    const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.classId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!classExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
    }

    // Validate stream if provided
    if (dto.streamId) {
      const streamExists = await this.prisma.stream.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.streamId, classId: dto.classId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!streamExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Stream not found');
      }
    }

    // Validate all subjects exist
    const subjectIds = dto.subjects.map((s) => s.subjectId);
    const subjects = await this.prisma.subject.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: subjectIds }, tenantId },
    });

    if (subjects.length !== subjectIds.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Some subjects not found');
    }

    // Create examination
    const examination = await this.prisma.examination.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        name: dto.name,
        description: dto.description,
        termId: dto.termId,
        classId: dto.classId,
        streamId: dto.streamId,
        examinationType: dto.examinationType,
        gradingSystem: dto.gradingSystem,
        startDate: dto.startDate ? new Date(dto.startDate) : null,
        endDate: dto.endDate ? new Date(dto.endDate) : null,
        createdBy: userId,
      },
    });

    // Create subject configurations
    await this.prisma.examinationSubject.createMany({
      data: dto.subjects.map((subject) => ({
        examinationId: examination.id,
        subjectId: subject.subjectId,
        totalMarks: subject.totalMarks,
        passMark: subject.passMark,
        weight: subject.weight || 1.0,
      })),
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Examination created: ${examination.name} for ${classExists.name}`,
    );

    return this.findOneExamination(examination.id);
  }

  async findAllExaminations(
    termId?: string,
    classId?: string,
    streamId?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (termId) {
      where.termId = termId;
    }

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    if (streamId) {
      where.streamId = streamId;
    }

    const examinations = await this.prisma.examination.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        term: {
          select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
        },
        class: {
          select: { name: true, level: true },
        },
        stream: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        _count: {
          select: { grades: true },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return examinations;
  }

  async findOneExamination(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const examination = await this.prisma.examination.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        term: true,
        class: true,
        stream: true,
        subjects: {
          include: {
            subject: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
                code: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!examination) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Examination not found');
    }

    return examination;
  }

  async updateExamination(
    id: string,
    dto: UpdateExaminationDto,
    userId?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    await this.findOneExamination(id);

    const updated = await this.prisma.examination.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.name && { name: dto.name }),
        ...(dto.description !== undefined && { description: dto.description }),
        ...(dto.startDate && { startDate: new Date(dto.startDate) }),
        ...(dto.endDate && { endDate: new Date(dto.endDate) }),
      },
    });

    return this.findOneExamination(updated.id);
  }

  async deleteExamination(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const examination = await this.findOneExamination(id);

    // Check if grades have been entered
    const gradesCount = await this.prisma.grade.count({
      where: { examinationId: id },
    });

    if (gradesCount > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Cannot delete examination with existing grades',
      );
    }

    // Delete subject configurations first
    await this.prisma.examinationSubject.deleteMany({
      where: { examinationId: id },
    });

    // Delete examination
    await this.prisma.examination.delete({
      where: { id },
    });

    return { success: true, message: 'Examination deleted successfully' };
  }

  // ==================== GRADES ====================

  async enterGrade(dto: EnterGradeDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate examination exists
    const examination = await this.findOneExamination(dto.examinationId);

    // Validate student exists and belongs to the class
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: {
        id: dto.studentId,
        tenantId,
        currentClassId: examination.classId,
        ...(examination.streamId && { currentStreamId: examination.streamId }),
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        'Student not found or does not belong to examination class',
      );
    }

    // Validate subject is part of examination
    const examSubject = await this.prisma.examinationSubject.findFirst({
      where: {
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
    });

    if (!examSubject) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Subject not part of this examination');
    }

    // Validate score doesn't exceed total marks
    if (dto.score > examSubject.totalMarks) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Score (${dto.score}) exceeds total marks (${examSubject.totalMarks})`,
      );
    }

    // Check for existing grade
    const existing = await this.prisma.grade.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException('Grade already entered for this student/subject');
    }

    // Calculate grade and position
    const percentage = (dto.score / examSubject.totalMarks) * 100;
    const letterGrade = this.calculateLetterGrade(percentage);

    // Create grade
    const grade = await this.prisma.grade.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
        score: dto.score,
        totalMarks: examSubject.totalMarks,
        percentage: Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100,
        letterGrade,
        competencyLevel: dto.competencyLevel,
        remarks: dto.remarks,
        enteredBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        subject: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Grade entered: ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} - ${examSubject.totalMarks} - ${dto.score}`,
    );

    return grade;
  }

  async bulkEnterGrades(dto: BulkEnterGradesDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate examination and subject
    const examination = await this.findOneExamination(dto.examinationId);

    const examSubject = await this.prisma.examinationSubject.findFirst({
      where: {
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
    });

    if (!examSubject) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Subject not part of this examination');
    }

    // Validate all students
    const studentIds = dto.grades.map((g) => g.studentId);
    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where: {
        id: { in: studentIds },
        tenantId,
        currentClassId: examination.classId,
      },
    });

    if (students.length !== studentIds.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Some students not found or not in class');
    }

    // Check for existing grades
    const existing = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: { in: studentIds },
        examinationId: dto.examinationId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
      },
    });

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Grades already exist for ${existing.length} student(s)`,
      );
    }

    // Validate scores
    for (const grade of dto.grades) {
      if (grade.score > examSubject.totalMarks) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Score ${grade.score} exceeds total marks ${examSubject.totalMarks}`,
        );
      }
    }

    // Create grades in transaction
    const grades = await this.prisma.$transaction(
      dto.grades.map((grade) => {
        const percentage = (grade.score / examSubject.totalMarks) * 100;
        const letterGrade = this.calculateLetterGrade(percentage);

        return this.prisma.grade.create({
          data: {
            tenantId,
            studentId: grade.studentId,
            examinationId: dto.examinationId,
            subjectId: dto.subjectId,
            score: grade.score,
            totalMarks: examSubject.totalMarks,
            percentage: Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100,
            letterGrade,
            competencyLevel: grade.competencyLevel,
            remarks: grade.remarks,
            enteredBy: userId,
          },
        });
      }),
    );

    this.logger.log(
      `Bulk grades entered: ${grades.length} students for subject ${dto.subjectId}`,
    );

    return {
      success: true,
      gradesEntered: grades.length,
      examinationId: dto.examinationId,
      subjectId: dto.subjectId,
    };
  }

  async updateGrade(id: string, dto: UpdateGradeDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const grade = await this.prisma.grade.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!grade) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Grade not found');
    }

    let percentage = grade.percentage;
    let letterGrade = grade.letterGrade;

    if (dto.score !== undefined) {
      percentage = (dto.score / grade.totalMarks) * 100;
      letterGrade = this.calculateLetterGrade(percentage);
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.grade.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.score !== undefined && {
          score: dto.score,
          percentage: Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100,
          letterGrade,
        }),
        ...(dto.competencyLevel && { competencyLevel: dto.competencyLevel }),
        ...(dto.remarks !== undefined && { remarks: dto.remarks }),
        enteredBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        subject: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  async queryGrades(query: QueryGradesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { examinationId, studentId, subjectId, classId, termId } = query;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (examinationId) {
      where.examinationId = examinationId;
    }

    if (studentId) {
      where.studentId = studentId;
    }

    if (subjectId) {
      where.subjectId = subjectId;
    }

    if (classId || termId) {
      where.examination = {};
      if (classId) {
        where.examination.classId = classId;
      }
      if (termId) {
        where.examination.termId = termId;
      }
    }

    const grades = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        subject: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        examination: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            examinationType: true,
            gradingSystem: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [
        { examination: { createdAt: 'desc' } },
        { student: { lastName: 'asc' } },
      ],
    });

    return grades;
  }

  // ==================== REPORT CARDS ====================

  async generateReportCard(dto: GenerateReportCardDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate student and term
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.studentId, tenantId },
      include: {
        currentClass: true,
        currentStream: true,
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    const term = await this.prisma.term.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.termId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!term) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Term not found');
    }

    // Check if report card already exists
    const existing = await this.prisma.reportCard.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        termId: dto.termId,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException('Report card already generated for this term');
    }

    // Get all grades for this student in this term
    const grades = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        examination: {
          termId: dto.termId,
        },
      },
      include: {
        subject: true,
        examination: true,
      },
    });

    if (grades.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'No grades found for this student in this term',
      );
    }

    // Calculate overall statistics
    const totalScore = grades.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.score, 0);
    const totalPossible = grades.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.totalMarks, 0);
    const averagePercentage = (totalScore / totalPossible) * 100;
    const overallGrade = this.calculateLetterGrade(averagePercentage);

    // Create report card
    const reportCard = await this.prisma.reportCard.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        termId: dto.termId,
        classId: student.currentClassId,
        streamId: student.currentStreamId,
        totalScore,
        averagePercentage: Math.round(averagePercentage * 100) / 100,
        overallGrade,
        classTeacherComments: dto.classTeacherComments,
        principalComments: dto.principalComments,
        status: ReportCardStatus.DRAFT,
        generatedBy: userId,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        term: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            termNumber: true,
          },
        },
        class: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Report card generated: ${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} - ${term.name}`,
    );

    return reportCard;
  }

  async bulkGenerateReportCards(dto: BulkGenerateReportCardsDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get all students in the class/stream
    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      currentClassId: dto.classId,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (dto.streamId) {
      where.currentStreamId = dto.streamId;
    }

    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where,
      select: { id: true, firstName: true, lastName: true },
    });

    if (students.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('No students found in this class/stream');
    }

    const results = {
      total: students.length,
      generated: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    for (const student of students) {
      try {
        await this.generateReportCard(
          {
            studentId: student.id,
            termId: dto.termId,
          },
          userId,
        );
        results.generated++;
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof ConflictException) {
          results.skipped++;
        } else {
          results.errors.push({
            student: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName}`,
            error: error.message,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  async findAllReportCards(query: QueryReportCardsDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { termId, studentId, classId, status } = query;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (termId) {
      where.termId = termId;
    }

    if (studentId) {
      where.studentId = studentId;
    }

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    if (status) {
      where.status = status;
    }

    const reportCards = await this.prisma.reportCard.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        term: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            termNumber: true,
          },
        },
        class: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [{ term: { termNumber: 'desc' } }, { student: { lastName: 'asc' } }],
    });

    return reportCards;
  }

  async findOneReportCard(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const reportCard = await this.prisma.reportCard.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        student: {
          include: {
            currentClass: true,
            currentStream: true,
          },
        },
        term: true,
        class: true,
        stream: true,
      },
    });

    if (!reportCard) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Report card not found');
    }

    // Get all grades for this report card
    const grades = await this.prisma.grade.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: reportCard.studentId,
        examination: {
          termId: reportCard.termId,
        },
      },
      include: {
        subject: true,
        examination: {
          select: {
            name: true,
            examinationType: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { subject: { name: 'asc' } },
    });

    return {
      ...reportCard,
      grades,
    };
  }

  async updateReportCard(id: string, dto: UpdateReportCardDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    await this.findOneReportCard(id);

    const updated = await this.prisma.reportCard.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.classTeacherComments !== undefined && {
          classTeacherComments: dto.classTeacherComments,
        }),
        ...(dto.principalComments !== undefined && {
          principalComments: dto.principalComments,
        }),
        ...(dto.status && { status: dto.status }),
      },
    });

    return this.findOneReportCard(updated.id);
  }

  async approveReportCard(dto: ApproveReportCardDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const reportCard = await this.findOneReportCard(dto.reportCardId);

    if (reportCard.status === ReportCardStatus.PUBLISHED) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Report card already published');
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.reportCard.update({
      where: { id: dto.reportCardId },
      data: {
        status: ReportCardStatus.APPROVED,
        principalComments: dto.principalComments || reportCard.principalComments,
        approvedBy: userId,
        approvedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    return this.findOneReportCard(updated.id);
  }

  // ==================== UTILITIES ====================

  private calculateLetterGrade(percentage: number): string {
    if (percentage >= 80) return 'A';
    if (percentage >= 70) return 'B';
    if (percentage >= 60) return 'C';
    if (percentage >= 50) return 'D';
    return 'E';
  }

  async getExaminationStats(examinationId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const [totalGrades, gradeDistribution, subjectStats] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.grade.count({
        where: { tenantId, examinationId },
      }),
      this.prisma.grade.groupBy({
        by: ['letterGrade'],
        where: { tenantId, examinationId },
        _count: true,
      }),
      this.prisma.grade.groupBy({
        by: ['subjectId'],
        where: { tenantId, examinationId },
        _avg: { percentage: true },
        _count: true,
      }),
    ]);

    const distribution = gradeDistribution.reduce((acc, item) => {
      acc[item.letterGrade] = item._count;
      return acc;
    }, {} as any);

    return {
      totalGrades,
      distribution,
      subjectStats,
    };
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateFeeStructureDto } from './dto/create-fee-structure.dto';
import { CreateInvoiceDto } from './dto/create-invoice.dto';
import { RecordPaymentDto } from './dto/record-payment.dto';
import { QueryInvoicesDto } from './dto/query-invoices.dto';
import { GenerateInvoicesDto } from './dto/generate-invoices.dto';
import { formatCurrency } from '@krypton/utils';

@Injectable()
export class FeesService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== FEE STRUCTURES ====================

  async createFeeStructure(dto: CreateFeeStructureDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate term exists
    const term = await this.prisma.term.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.termId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!term) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Term not found');
    }

    // Validate class if provided
    if (dto.classId) {
      const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.classId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!classExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
      }
    }

    // Create fee structure with items
    const feeStructure = await this.prisma.feeStructure.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        name: dto.name,
        description: dto.description,
        termId: dto.termId,
        classId: dto.classId,
        isActive: true,
        feeItems: {
          create: dto.feeItems.map((item) => ({
            name: item.name,
            description: item.description,
            amount: item.amount,
            feeCategory: item.feeCategory,
            isOptional: item.isOptional || false,
            sortOrder: item.sortOrder || 0,
          })),
        },
      },
      include: {
        feeItems: {
          orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        },
        term: {
          select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
        },
        class: {
          select: { name: true, level: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return feeStructure;
  }

  async findAllFeeStructures(termId?: string, classId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (termId) {
      where.termId = termId;
    }

    if (classId) {
      where.classId = classId;
    }

    const feeStructures = await this.prisma.feeStructure.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        feeItems: {
          orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        },
        term: {
          select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
        },
        class: {
          select: { name: true, level: true },
        },
        _count: {
          select: { invoices: true },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return feeStructures;
  }

  async findOneFeeStructure(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const feeStructure = await this.prisma.feeStructure.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        feeItems: {
          orderBy: { sortOrder: 'asc' },
        },
        term: true,
        class: true,
      },
    });

    if (!feeStructure) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Fee structure not found');
    }

    return feeStructure;
  }

  async deactivateFeeStructure(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    await this.findOneFeeStructure(id);

    const updated = await this.prisma.feeStructure.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { isActive: false },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  // ==================== INVOICES ====================

  async createInvoice(dto: CreateInvoiceDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate student exists
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.studentId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Student not found');
    }

    // Validate term exists
    const term = await this.prisma.term.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.termId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!term) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Term not found');
    }

    // Check if invoice already exists for this student and term
    const existing = await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        termId: dto.termId,
        status: { not: 'CANCELLED' },
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException('Invoice already exists for this student and term');
    }

    // Calculate total amount
    const totalAmount = dto.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);

    // Generate invoice number
    const invoiceNumber = await this.generateInvoiceNumber();

    // Create invoice with items
    const invoice = await this.prisma.invoice.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        invoiceNumber,
        studentId: dto.studentId,
        termId: dto.termId,
        totalAmount,
        paidAmount: 0,
        balanceAmount: totalAmount,
        status: 'PENDING',
        dueDate: dto.dueDate ? new Date(dto.dueDate) : null,
        invoiceItems: {
          create: dto.items.map((item) => ({
            description: item.description,
            amount: item.amount,
            feeCategory: item.feeCategory,
          })),
        },
      },
      include: {
        invoiceItems: true,
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
        term: {
          select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return invoice;
  }

  async generateInvoices(dto: GenerateInvoicesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get fee structure
    const feeStructure = await this.findOneFeeStructure(dto.feeStructureId);

    if (!feeStructure.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Fee structure is not active');
    }

    // Get students to generate invoices for
    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (dto.classId) {
      where.currentClassId = dto.classId;
    } else if (feeStructure.classId) {
      where.currentClassId = feeStructure.classId;
    }

    if (dto.streamId) {
      where.currentStreamId = dto.streamId;
    }

    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where,
      select: { id: true, admissionNumber: true, firstName: true, lastName: true },
    });

    if (students.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('No students found matching criteria');
    }

    // Generate invoices
    const results = {
      total: students.length,
      created: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    for (const student of students) {
      try {
        // Check if invoice already exists
        const existing = await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({
          where: {
            tenantId,
            studentId: student.id,
            termId: feeStructure.termId,
            status: { not: 'CANCELLED' },
          },
        });

        if (existing) {
          results.skipped++;
          continue;
        }

        // Create invoice
        const items = feeStructure.feeItems.map((item) => ({
          description: item.description,
          amount: item.amount,
          feeCategory: item.feeCategory,
        }));

        await this.createInvoice({
          studentId: student.id,
          termId: feeStructure.termId,
          items,
          dueDate: dto.dueDate,
        });

        results.created++;
      } catch (error) {
        results.errors.push({
          student: `${student.firstName} ${student.lastName} (${student.admissionNumber})`,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  async findAllInvoices(query: QueryInvoicesDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { page = 1, pageSize = 20, ...filters } = query;

    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (filters.studentId) {
      where.studentId = filters.studentId;
    }

    if (filters.termId) {
      where.termId = filters.termId;
    }

    if (filters.status) {
      where.status = filters.status;
    }

    const [invoices, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.invoice.findMany({
        where,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
        include: {
          student: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              admissionNumber: true,
              firstName: true,
              lastName: true,
              currentClass: {
                select: { name: true },
              },
            },
          },
          term: {
            select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
          },
          _count: {
            select: { payments: true },
          },
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      }),
      this.prisma.invoice.count({ where }),
    ]);

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

    return {
      data: invoices,
      meta: {
        page,
        pageSize,
        total,
        totalPages,
        hasNextPage: page < totalPages,
        hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
      },
    };
  }

  async findOneInvoice(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const invoice = await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        invoiceItems: true,
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
            middleName: true,
            currentClass: {
              select: { name: true, level: true },
            },
            currentStream: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
          },
        },
        term: true,
        payments: {
          orderBy: { paymentDate: 'desc' },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!invoice) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Invoice not found');
    }

    return invoice;
  }

  async cancelInvoice(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const invoice = await this.findOneInvoice(id);

    if (invoice.paidAmount > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot cancel invoice with payments');
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.invoice.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { status: 'CANCELLED' },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  // ==================== PAYMENTS ====================

  async recordPayment(dto: RecordPaymentDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Get invoice
    const invoice = await this.findOneInvoice(dto.invoiceId);

    if (invoice.status === 'CANCELLED') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot add payment to cancelled invoice');
    }

    if (invoice.status === 'PAID') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invoice is already fully paid');
    }

    // Check if payment amount exceeds balance
    if (dto.amount > invoice.balanceAmount) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Payment amount (${formatCurrency(dto.amount)}) exceeds invoice balance (${formatCurrency(invoice.balanceAmount)})`
      );
    }

    // Check for duplicate reference
    const existingPayment = await this.prisma.payment.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        reference: dto.reference,
      },
    });

    if (existingPayment) {
      throw new ConflictException(`Payment with reference ${dto.reference} already exists`);
    }

    // Generate receipt number
    const receiptNumber = await this.generateReceiptNumber();

    // Create payment and update invoice in transaction
    const payment = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Create payment
      const newPayment = await tx.payment.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
          amount: dto.amount,
          paymentMethod: dto.paymentMethod,
          reference: dto.reference,
          status: 'COMPLETED',
          paymentDate: dto.paymentDate ? new Date(dto.paymentDate) : new Date(),
          receiptNumber,
          receiptIssued: true,
          receiptIssuedAt: new Date(),
          notes: dto.notes,
          processedBy: userId,
        },
      });

      // Update invoice
      const newPaidAmount = invoice.paidAmount + dto.amount;
      const newBalanceAmount = invoice.totalAmount - newPaidAmount;
      const newStatus =
        newBalanceAmount === 0 ? 'PAID' : newPaidAmount > 0 ? 'PARTIALLY_PAID' : 'PENDING';

      await tx.invoice.update({
        where: { id: dto.invoiceId },
        data: {
          paidAmount: newPaidAmount,
          balanceAmount: newBalanceAmount,
          status: newStatus,
        },
      });

      return newPayment;
    });

    // Return payment with invoice details
    return this.prisma.payment.findUnique({
      where: { id: payment.id },
      include: {
        invoice: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
              },
            },
            term: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });
  }

  async findAllPayments(invoiceId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (invoiceId) {
      where.invoiceId = invoiceId;
    }

    const payments = await this.prisma.payment.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        invoice: {
          select: {
            invoiceNumber: true,
            student: {
              select: {
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { paymentDate: 'desc' },
    });

    return payments;
  }

  async findOnePayment(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const payment = await this.prisma.payment.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        invoice: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                currentClass: {
                  select: { name: true },
                },
              },
            },
            term: {
              select: { name: true, termNumber: true },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!payment) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Payment not found');
    }

    return payment;
  }

  // ==================== FINANCIAL REPORTS ====================

  async getFinancialSummary(termId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (termId) {
      where.termId = termId;
    }

    const [invoices, totalExpected, totalCollected, overdueInvoices] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.invoice.count({
        where: { ...where, status: { not: 'CANCELLED' } },
      }),
      this.prisma.invoice.aggregate({
        where: { ...where, status: { not: 'CANCELLED' } },
        _sum: { totalAmount: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.invoice.aggregate({
        where: { ...where, status: { not: 'CANCELLED' } },
        _sum: { paidAmount: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.invoice.count({
        where: {
          ...where,
          status: 'OVERDUE',
        },
      }),
    ]);

    const expected = totalExpected._sum.totalAmount || 0;
    const collected = totalCollected._sum.paidAmount || 0;
    const outstanding = expected - collected;
    const collectionRate = expected > 0 ? (collected / expected) * 100 : 0;

    return {
      totalInvoices: invoices,
      totalExpected: expected,
      totalCollected: collected,
      outstanding,
      collectionRate: Math.round(collectionRate * 100) / 100,
      overdueInvoices,
    };
  }

  // ==================== UTILITIES ====================

  private async generateInvoiceNumber(): Promise<string> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const count = await this.prisma.invoice.count({
      where: { tenantId },
    });

    return `INV-${year}-${String(count + 1).padStart(6, '0')}`;
  }

  private async generateReceiptNumber(): Promise<string> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const count = await this.prisma.payment.count({
      where: { tenantId },
    });

    return `RCT-${year}-${String(count + 1).padStart(6, '0')}`;
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateGuardianDto } from './dto/create-guardian.dto';
import { UpdateGuardianDto } from './dto/update-guardian.dto';
import { LinkStudentDto } from './dto/link-student.dto';

@Injectable()
export class GuardiansService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  async create(createGuardianDto: CreateGuardianDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        ...createGuardianDto,
      },
    });

    return guardian;
  }

  async findAll(search?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { firstName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { lastName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { phone: { contains: search } },
        { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    const guardians = await this.prisma.guardian.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        studentLinks: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                status: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'desc',
      },
    });

    return guardians;
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        studentLinks: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                middleName: true,
                dateOfBirth: true,
                gender: true,
                status: true,
                currentClass: {
                  select: {
                    name: true,
                    level: true,
                  },
                },
                currentStream: {
                  select: {
                    name: true,
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!guardian) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Guardian with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return guardian;
  }

  async update(id: string, updateGuardianDto: UpdateGuardianDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.update({
      where: { id },
      data: updateGuardianDto,
    });

    return guardian;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Check if guardian is linked to any students
    const links = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.count({
      where: { guardianId: id },
    });

    if (links > 0) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        'Cannot delete guardian who is linked to students. Remove student links first.'
      );
    }

    await this.prisma.guardian.delete({
      where: { id },
    });

    return { message: 'Guardian deleted successfully' };
  }

  async linkStudent(id: string, linkStudentDto: LinkStudentDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Verify student exists and belongs to same tenant
    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: {
        id: linkStudentDto.studentId,
        tenantId,
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Student with ID ${linkStudentDto.studentId} not found`);
    }

    // Check if link already exists
    const existingLink = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: {
        guardianId: id,
        studentId: linkStudentDto.studentId,
      },
    });

    if (existingLink) {
      throw new ConflictException('Guardian is already linked to this student');
    }

    // If setting as primary, unset other primary guardians for this student
    if (linkStudentDto.isPrimary) {
      await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.updateMany({
        where: {
          studentId: linkStudentDto.studentId,
          isPrimary: true,
        },
        data: {
          isPrimary: false,
        },
      });
    }

    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.create({
      data: {
        guardianId: id,
        studentId: linkStudentDto.studentId,
        relationship: linkStudentDto.relationship as any,
        isPrimary: linkStudentDto.isPrimary || false,
        canPickup: linkStudentDto.canPickup !== false,
        receiveUpdates: linkStudentDto.receiveUpdates !== false,
      },
      include: {
        student: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            admissionNumber: true,
            firstName: true,
            lastName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    return link;
  }

  async unlinkStudent(id: string, studentId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify guardian exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    const link = await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.findFirst({
      where: {
        guardianId: id,
        studentId,
      },
    });

    if (!link) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Link not found between guardian and student');
    }

    await this.prisma.guardianStudentLink.delete({
      where: { id: link.id },
    });

    return { message: 'Student unlinked successfully' };
  }

  async getStudents(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const guardian = await this.prisma.guardian.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        studentLinks: {
          include: {
            student: {
              include: {
                currentClass: true,
                currentStream: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!guardian) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Guardian with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return guardian.studentLinks.map((link) => ({
      ...link.student,
      relationship: link.relationship,
      isPrimary: link.isPrimary,
    }));
  }
}

  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: 'Payment manually reconciled',

  @ApiResponse({ status: 400, description: 'Invalid data' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Invoice not found' })

  @Roles(
    UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN,
    UserRole.SCHOOL_OWNER,
    UserRole.PRINCIPAL,
    UserRole.DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL,
    UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN,
    UserRole.ACCOUNTANT,
    UserRole.PARENT,
  )
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get M-Pesa transaction by ID' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', description: 'Transaction ID' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Transaction retrieved' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Transaction not found' })
  getTransactionById(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.mpesaService.getTransactionById(id);
  }

  @Get('stats')
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, TenantGuard, RolesGuard)
  @Roles(
    UserRole.SUPER_ADMIN,
    UserRole.SCHOOL_OWNER,
    UserRole.PRINCIPAL,
    UserRole.DEPUTY_PRINCIPAL,
    UserRole.SCHOOL_ADMIN,
    UserRole.ACCOUNTANT,
  )
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get M-Pesa transaction statistics' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Statistics retrieved' })
  getTransactionStats() {
    return this.mpesaService.getTransactionStats();
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  BadRequestException,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  Logger,
  InternalServerErrorException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { FeesService } from '../fees/fees.service';
import {
  InitiateSTKPushDto,
  STKPushResponseDto,
  STKPushCallbackDto,
  QuerySTKStatusDto,
} from './dto/stk-push.dto';
import {
  C2BCallbackDto,
  C2BValidationDto,
  C2BValidationResponseDto,
  C2BConfirmationResponseDto,
} from './dto/c2b-callback.dto';
import {
  ReconcileTransactionDto,
  QueryUnmatchedTransactionsDto,
  ManualReconciliationDto,
  ReconciliationStatus,
  ReconciliationAction,
} from './dto/reconciliation.dto';
import axios from 'axios';

@Injectable()
export class MpesaService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(MpesaService.name);
  private readonly baseUrl: string;
  private readonly consumerKey: string;
  private readonly consumerSecret: string;
  private readonly shortCode: string;
  private readonly passkey: string;
  private readonly callbackUrl: string;
  private readonly validationUrl: string;
  private readonly confirmationUrl: string;
  private accessTokenCache: { token: string; expiresAt: number } | null = null;

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
    private feesService: FeesService,
    private configService: ConfigService,
  ) {
    this.baseUrl =
      this.configService.get('MPESA_BASE_URL') ||
      'https://sandbox.safaricom.co.ke';
    this.consumerKey = this.configService.get('MPESA_CONSUMER_KEY');
    this.consumerSecret = this.configService.get('MPESA_CONSUMER_SECRET');
    this.shortCode = this.configService.get('MPESA_SHORT_CODE');
    this.passkey = this.configService.get('MPESA_PASSKEY');
    this.callbackUrl = this.configService.get('MPESA_CALLBACK_URL');
    this.validationUrl = this.configService.get('MPESA_VALIDATION_URL');
    this.confirmationUrl = this.configService.get('MPESA_CONFIRMATION_URL');
  }

  // ==================== AUTHENTICATION ====================

  private async getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
    // Return cached token if still valid
    if (
      this.accessTokenCache &&
      this.accessTokenCache.expiresAt > Date.now()
    ) {
      return this.accessTokenCache.token;
    }

    try {
      const auth = Buffer.from(
        `${this.consumerKey}:${this.consumerSecret}`,
      ).toString('base64');

      const response = await axios.get(
        `${this.baseUrl}/oauth/v1/generate?grant_type=client_credentials`,
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Basic ${auth}`,
          },
        },
      );

      const { access_token, expires_in } = response.data;

      // Cache token (expire 1 minute early for safety)
      this.accessTokenCache = {
        token: access_token,
        expiresAt: Date.now() + (parseInt(expires_in) - 60) * 1000,
      };

      return access_token;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to get M-Pesa access token', error);
      throw new InternalServerErrorException(
        'Failed to authenticate with M-Pesa',
      );
    }
  }

  // ==================== STK PUSH ====================

  async initiateSTKPush(
    dto: InitiateSTKPushDto,
    userId?: string,
  ): Promise<STKPushResponseDto> {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate invoice exists and get details
    const invoice = await this.feesService.findOneInvoice(dto.invoiceId);

    if (invoice.status === 'CANCELLED') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot pay for cancelled invoice');
    }

    if (invoice.status === 'PAID') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invoice is already fully paid');
    }

    // Validate payment amount
    if (dto.amount > invoice.balanceAmount) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Payment amount exceeds invoice balance (${invoice.balanceAmount} cents)`,
      );
    }

    if (dto.amount < 100) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Minimum payment amount is KES 1.00');
    }

    // Generate timestamp and password
    const timestamp = new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
      .slice(0, 14);
    const password = Buffer.from(
      `${this.shortCode}${this.passkey}${timestamp}`,
    ).toString('base64');

    // Convert amount from cents to shillings
    const amountInShillings = Math.floor(dto.amount / 100);

    const accountReference =
      dto.accountReference || invoice.invoiceNumber || 'SCHOOL_FEE';
    const transactionDesc = dto.transactionDesc || 'School Fee Payment';

    try {
      const accessToken = await this.getAccessToken();

      const response = await axios.post(
        `${this.baseUrl}/mpesa/stkpush/v1/processrequest`,
        {
          BusinessShortCode: this.shortCode,
          Password: password,
          Timestamp: timestamp,
          TransactionType: 'CustomerPayBillOnline',
          Amount: amountInShillings,
          PartyA: dto.phoneNumber,
          PartyB: this.shortCode,
          PhoneNumber: dto.phoneNumber,
          CallBackURL: this.callbackUrl,
          AccountReference: accountReference,
          TransactionDesc: transactionDesc,
        },
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
        },
      );

      const {
        CheckoutRequestID,
        MerchantRequestID,
        ResponseCode,
        ResponseDescription,
        CustomerMessage,
      } = response.data;

      // Record transaction in database
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          transactionType: 'STK_PUSH',
          merchantRequestId: MerchantRequestID,
          checkoutRequestId: CheckoutRequestID,
          phoneNumber: dto.phoneNumber,
          amount: dto.amount,
          accountReference: accountReference,
          transactionDesc: transactionDesc,
          invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
          status: 'PENDING',
          initiatedBy: userId,
          responseCode: ResponseCode,
          responseDescription: ResponseDescription,
        },
      });

      this.logger.log(
        `STK Push initiated: ${CheckoutRequestID} for invoice ${dto.invoiceId}`,
      );

      return {
        checkoutRequestId: CheckoutRequestID,
        merchantRequestId: MerchantRequestID,
        responseCode: ResponseCode,
        responseDescription: ResponseDescription,
        customerMessage: CustomerMessage,
        invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
        amount: dto.amount,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('STK Push failed', error);

      if (error.response?.data) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          error.response.data.errorMessage ||
            'Failed to initiate M-Pesa payment',
        );
      }

      throw new InternalServerErrorException('Failed to initiate M-Pesa payment');
    }
  }

  async handleSTKCallback(callback: STKPushCallbackDto): Promise<void> {
    const { stkCallback } = callback.Body;
    const {
      MerchantRequestID,
      CheckoutRequestID,
      ResultCode,
      ResultDesc,
      CallbackMetadata,
    } = stkCallback;

    this.logger.log(`STK Callback received: ${CheckoutRequestID}`);

    // Find transaction
    const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
      where: {
        checkoutRequestId: CheckoutRequestID,
        merchantRequestId: MerchantRequestID,
      },
    });

    if (!transaction) {
      this.logger.error(`Transaction not found: ${CheckoutRequestID}`);
      return;
    }

    // Check if already processed
    if (transaction.callbackReceived) {
      this.logger.warn(
        `Duplicate callback received for: ${CheckoutRequestID}`,
      );
      return;
    }

    // Success
    if (ResultCode === 0 && CallbackMetadata) {
      const metadata = CallbackMetadata.Item.reduce((acc, item) => {
        acc[item.Name] = item.Value;
        return acc;
      }, {} as any);

      const mpesaReceiptNumber = metadata.MpesaReceiptNumber;
      const transactionDate = new Date(
        metadata.TransactionDate?.toString() || Date.now(),
      );
      const phoneNumber = metadata.PhoneNumber?.toString();

      // Update transaction with success details
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
        where: { id: transaction.id },
        data: {
          status: 'COMPLETED',
          resultCode: ResultCode,
          resultDesc: ResultDesc,
          mpesaReceiptNumber,
          transactionDate,
          phoneNumber: phoneNumber || transaction.phoneNumber,
          callbackReceived: true,
          callbackReceivedAt: new Date(),
          reconciliationStatus: 'PENDING',
        },
      });

      // Auto-allocate payment to invoice if not already done
      if (transaction.invoiceId && !transaction.paymentId) {
        try {
          const payment = await this.feesService.recordPayment(
            {
              invoiceId: transaction.invoiceId,
              amount: transaction.amount,
              paymentMethod: 'MPESA',
              reference: mpesaReceiptNumber,
              paymentDate: transactionDate.toISOString(),
              notes: `M-Pesa payment from ${phoneNumber}`,
            },
            transaction.initiatedBy,
          );

          // Link payment to transaction
          await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
            where: { id: transaction.id },
            data: {
              paymentId: payment.id,
              reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
            },
          });

          this.logger.log(
            `Payment auto-allocated: ${mpesaReceiptNumber} → Invoice ${transaction.invoiceId}`,
          );
        } catch (error) {
          this.logger.error('Failed to auto-allocate payment', error);
          // Mark as unmatched for manual reconciliation
          await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
            where: { id: transaction.id },
            data: { reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
          });
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Failed transaction
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
        where: { id: transaction.id },
        data: {
          status: 'FAILED',
          resultCode: ResultCode,
          resultDesc: ResultDesc,
          callbackReceived: true,
          callbackReceivedAt: new Date(),
          reconciliationStatus: 'FAILED',
        },
      });

      this.logger.warn(
        `STK Push failed: ${CheckoutRequestID} - ${ResultDesc}`,
      );
    }
  }

  async querySTKStatus(dto: QuerySTKStatusDto): Promise<any> {
    const timestamp = new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')
      .slice(0, 14);
    const password = Buffer.from(
      `${this.shortCode}${this.passkey}${timestamp}`,
    ).toString('base64');

    try {
      const accessToken = await this.getAccessToken();

      const response = await axios.post(
        `${this.baseUrl}/mpesa/stkpushquery/v1/query`,
        {
          BusinessShortCode: this.shortCode,
          Password: password,
          Timestamp: timestamp,
          CheckoutRequestID: dto.checkoutRequestId,
        },
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
        },
      );

      return response.data;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('STK status query failed', error);
      throw new BadRequestException('Failed to query transaction status');
    }
  }

  // ==================== C2B CALLBACKS ====================

  async validateC2BPayment(
    dto: C2BValidationDto,
  ): Promise<C2BValidationResponseDto> {
    this.logger.log(`C2B Validation: ${dto.TransID}`);

    // Basic validation - accept all valid transactions
    // You can add custom validation logic here (e.g., check invoice exists)

    if (dto.TransAmount < 1) {
      return {
        ResultCode: 1,
        ResultDesc: 'Invalid transaction amount',
      };
    }

    return {
      ResultCode: 0,
      ResultDesc: 'Accepted',
    };
  }

  async confirmC2BPayment(
    dto: C2BCallbackDto,
  ): Promise<C2BConfirmationResponseDto> {
    this.logger.log(`C2B Confirmation: ${dto.TransID}`);

    const tenantId = this.tenantService.getTenantContext();

    if (!tenantId) {
      this.logger.error('No tenant context for C2B callback');
      return {
        ResultCode: 1,
        ResultDesc: 'No tenant context',
      };
    }

    try {
      // Check for duplicate
      const existing = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          mpesaReceiptNumber: dto.TransID,
        },
      });

      if (existing) {
        this.logger.warn(`Duplicate C2B transaction: ${dto.TransID}`);
        return {
          ResultCode: 0,
          ResultDesc: 'Duplicate transaction',
        };
      }

      // Parse transaction date
      const transactionDate = this.parseTransactionTime(dto.TransTime);

      // Convert amount from shillings to cents
      const amountInCents = Math.floor(dto.TransAmount * 100);

      // Create transaction record
      const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          transactionType: 'C2B',
          mpesaReceiptNumber: dto.TransID,
          phoneNumber: dto.MSISDN,
          amount: amountInCents,
          accountReference: dto.BillRefNumber,
          transactionDate,
          status: 'COMPLETED',
          resultCode: 0,
          resultDesc: 'Success',
          callbackReceived: true,
          callbackReceivedAt: new Date(),
          reconciliationStatus: 'PENDING',
          metadata: {
            TransactionType: dto.TransactionType,
            FirstName: dto.FirstName,
            MiddleName: dto.MiddleName,
            LastName: dto.LastName,
            InvoiceNumber: dto.InvoiceNumber,
            OrgAccountBalance: dto.OrgAccountBalance,
          },
        },
      });

      // Try to auto-match with invoice
      await this.autoReconcileC2B(transaction.id, dto.BillRefNumber);

      return {
        ResultCode: 0,
        ResultDesc: 'Accepted',
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to process C2B confirmation', error);
      return {
        ResultCode: 1,
        ResultDesc: 'Failed to process payment',
      };
    }
  }

  private async autoReconcileC2B(
    transactionId: string,
    billReference: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // Try to find invoice by invoice number or admission number
      const invoice = await this.prisma.invoice.findFirst({
        where: {
          OR: [
            { invoiceNumber: billReference },
            {
              student: {
                admissionNumber: billReference,
              },
            },
          ],
          status: {
            not: 'CANCELLED',
          },
        },
      });

      if (!invoice) {
        this.logger.warn(
          `No invoice found for bill reference: ${billReference}`,
        );
        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: transactionId },
          data: { reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
        });
        return;
      }

      const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findUnique({
        where: { id: transactionId },
      });

      if (!transaction) return;

      // Check if amount matches or is less than balance
      if (transaction.amount > invoice.balanceAmount) {
        this.logger.warn(
          `Payment amount exceeds invoice balance for ${billReference}`,
        );
        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: transactionId },
          data: { reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
        });
        return;
      }

      // Record payment
      const payment = await this.feesService.recordPayment({
        invoiceId: invoice.id,
        amount: transaction.amount,
        paymentMethod: 'MPESA',
        reference: transaction.mpesaReceiptNumber,
        paymentDate: transaction.transactionDate?.toISOString(),
        notes: `C2B payment from ${transaction.phoneNumber}`,
      });

      // Update transaction
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
        where: { id: transactionId },
        data: {
          invoiceId: invoice.id,
          paymentId: payment.id,
          reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
        },
      });

      this.logger.log(
        `C2B payment auto-reconciled: ${transaction.mpesaReceiptNumber} → Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNumber}`,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Auto-reconciliation failed', error);
      await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
        where: { id: transactionId },
        data: { reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
      });
    }
  }

  // ==================== RECONCILIATION ====================

  async queryUnmatchedTransactions(query: QueryUnmatchedTransactionsDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { page = 1, pageSize = 20, status, startDate, endDate } = query;

    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      reconciliationStatus: status || 'UNMATCHED',
    };

    if (startDate || endDate) {
      where.transactionDate = {};
      if (startDate) {
        where.transactionDate.gte = new Date(startDate);
      }
      if (endDate) {
        where.transactionDate.lte = new Date(endDate);
      }
    }

    const [transactions, total] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findMany({
        where,
        skip,
        take: pageSize,
        orderBy: { transactionDate: 'desc' },
      }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: transactions,
      meta: {
        page,
        pageSize,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
        hasNextPage: page < Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
        hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
      },
    };
  }

  async reconcileTransaction(dto: ReconcileTransactionDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.transactionId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!transaction) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Transaction not found');
    }

    switch (dto.action) {
      case ReconciliationAction.MATCH:
        if (!dto.invoiceId) {
          throw new BadRequestException('Invoice ID required for matching');
        }

        // Record payment
        const payment = await this.feesService.recordPayment({
          invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
          amount: transaction.amount,
          paymentMethod: 'MPESA',
          reference: transaction.mpesaReceiptNumber,
          paymentDate: transaction.transactionDate?.toISOString(),
          notes: dto.notes || `Manual reconciliation by user ${userId}`,
        });

        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: dto.transactionId },
          data: {
            invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
            paymentId: payment.id,
            reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
          },
        });

        return { success: true, message: 'Transaction matched successfully' };

      case ReconciliationAction.UNMATCH:
        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: dto.transactionId },
          data: {
            reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED',
          },
        });

        return { success: true, message: 'Transaction unmatched' };

      case ReconciliationAction.MARK_DUPLICATE:
        await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
          where: { id: dto.transactionId },
          data: {
            reconciliationStatus: 'DUPLICATE',
          },
        });

        return { success: true, message: 'Transaction marked as duplicate' };

      default:
        throw new BadRequestException('Invalid reconciliation action');
    }
  }

  async manualReconciliation(dto: ManualReconciliationDto, userId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Check if transaction exists
    const existing = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        mpesaReceiptNumber: dto.mpesaReference,
      },
    });

    let transaction;

    if (existing) {
      transaction = existing;
    } else {
      // Create manual transaction record
      transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          transactionType: 'MANUAL',
          mpesaReceiptNumber: dto.mpesaReference,
          phoneNumber: dto.customerPhone,
          amount: dto.amount,
          invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
          transactionDate: dto.transactionDate
            ? new Date(dto.transactionDate)
            : new Date(),
          status: 'COMPLETED',
          resultCode: 0,
          resultDesc: 'Manual entry',
          callbackReceived: true,
          callbackReceivedAt: new Date(),
          reconciliationStatus: 'PENDING',
          initiatedBy: userId,
        },
      });
    }

    // Record payment
    const payment = await this.feesService.recordPayment({
      invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
      amount: dto.amount,
      paymentMethod: 'MPESA',
      reference: dto.mpesaReference,
      paymentDate: dto.transactionDate,
      notes: dto.notes || 'Manual reconciliation',
    });

    // Update transaction
    await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.update({
      where: { id: transaction.id },
      data: {
        invoiceId: dto.invoiceId,
        paymentId: payment.id,
        reconciliationStatus: 'MATCHED',
      },
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Payment manually reconciled',
      paymentId: payment.id,
    };
  }

  // ==================== UTILITIES ====================

  private parseTransactionTime(transTime: string): Date {
    // Format: YYYYMMDDHHmmss
    const year = parseInt(transTime.substring(0, 4));
    const month = parseInt(transTime.substring(4, 6)) - 1;
    const day = parseInt(transTime.substring(6, 8));
    const hour = parseInt(transTime.substring(8, 10));
    const minute = parseInt(transTime.substring(10, 12));
    const second = parseInt(transTime.substring(12, 14));

    return new Date(year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
  }

  async getTransactionById(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const transaction = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        invoice: {
          include: {
            student: {
              select: {
                admissionNumber: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
        payment: true,
      },
    });

    if (!transaction) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Transaction not found');
    }

    return transaction;
  }

  async getTransactionStats() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const [total, completed, pending, failed, unmatched] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'COMPLETED' },
      }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'PENDING' },
      }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'FAILED' },
      }),
      this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.count({
        where: { tenantId, reconciliationStatus: 'UNMATCHED' },
      }),
    ]);

    const totalAmount = await this.prisma.mpesaTransaction.aggregate({
      where: { tenantId, status: 'COMPLETED' },
      _sum: { amount: true },
    });

    return {
      total,
      completed,
      pending,
      failed,
      unmatched,
      totalAmount: totalAmount._sum.amount || 0,
    };
  }
}

export class CreateStudentDto {
  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Student admission number (unique per school)',
    example: 'STD001',
  })
  @IsString()
  @MinLength(3)
  @MaxLength(20)
  @Matches(/^[A-Z0-9]+$/, {
    message: 'Admission number must contain only uppercase letters and numbers',
  })
  admissionNumber: string;

  @ApiProperty({ description: 'Student first name', example: 'Jane' })
  @IsString()

  @MaxLength(50)
  firstName: string;

  @ApiProperty({ description: 'Student last name', example: 'Wanjiku' })
  @IsString()

  @MaxLength(50)
  lastName: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ description: 'Student middle name', example: 'Njeri' })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(50)
  middleName?: string;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Date of birth',
    example: '2015-05-15',
  })
  @IsDateString()
  dateOfBirth: string;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Student gender',
    enum: Gender,
    example: Gender.FEMALE,
  })
  @IsEnum(Gender)
  gender: Gender;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    description: 'National ID number',
    example: '12345678',
  })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @Matches(/^\d{7,8}$/, {
    message: 'National ID must be 7-8 digits',
  })

  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    description: 'Birth certificate number',

  @IsOptional()

File: apps/api/src/modules/students/students.service.ts
