import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import { CreateStudentDto } from './dto/create-student.dto';
import { UpdateStudentDto } from './dto/update-student.dto';
import { QueryStudentsDto } from './dto/query-students.dto';
import { AssignClassDto } from './dto/assign-class.dto';
import { formatFullName } from '@krypton/utils';

@Injectable()
export class StudentsService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  async create(createStudentDto: CreateStudentDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Check if admission number already exists
    const existing = await this.prisma.student.findUnique({
      where: {
        tenantId_admissionNumber: {
          tenantId,
          admissionNumber: createStudentDto.admissionNumber,
        },
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Admission number ${createStudentDto.admissionNumber} already exists`
      );
    }

    // Validate class and stream if provided
    if (createStudentDto.currentClassId) {
      await this.validateClass(createStudentDto.currentClassId);
    }

    if (createStudentDto.currentStreamId) {
      await this.validateStream(createStudentDto.currentStreamId);
    }

    // Extract guardians data
    const { guardians, ...studentData } = createStudentDto;

    // Create student with guardians in a transaction
    const student = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Create student
      const newStudent = await tx.student.create({
        data: {
          tenantId,
          ...studentData,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        },
      });

      // Create or link guardians
      for (const guardianInfo of guardians) {
        let guardian;

        if (guardianInfo.guardianId) {
          // Link existing guardian
          guardian = await tx.guardian.findUnique({
            where: { id: guardianInfo.guardianId },
          });

          if (!guardian || guardian.tenantId !== tenantId) {
            throw new NotFoundException(`Guardian ${guardianInfo.guardianId} not found`);
          }
        } else {
          // Create new guardian
          guardian = await tx.guardian.create({
            data: {
              tenantId,
              firstName: guardianInfo.firstName,
              lastName: guardianInfo.lastName,
              middleName: guardianInfo.middleName,
              phone: guardianInfo.phone,
              email: guardianInfo.email,
              occupation: guardianInfo.occupation,
              address: guardianInfo.address,
            },
          });
        }

        // Create link
        await tx.guardianStudentLink.create({
          data: {
            guardianId: guardian.id,
            studentId: newStudent.id,
            relationship: guardianInfo.relationship as any,
            isPrimary: guardianInfo.isPrimary || false,
            canPickup: true,
            receiveUpdates: true,
          },
        });
      }

      // Return student with guardians
      return tx.student.findUnique({
        where: { id: newStudent.id },
        include: {
          currentClass: {
            select: { id: true, name: true, level: true },
          },
          currentStream: {
            select: { id: true, name: true },
          },
          guardianLinks: {
            include: {
              guardian: {
                select: {
                  id: true,
                  firstName: true,
                  lastName: true,
                  phone: true,
                  email: true,
                  relationship: false,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      });
    });

    return student;
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryStudentsDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();
    const { page = 1, pageSize = 20, search, sortBy = 'createdAt', sortOrder = 'desc', ...filters } = query;

    const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;

    // Build where clause
    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (search) {
      where.OR = [
        { firstName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { lastName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { admissionNumber: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      ];
    }

    if (filters.classId) {
      where.currentClassId = filters.classId;
    }

    if (filters.streamId) {
      where.currentStreamId = filters.streamId;
    }

    if (filters.status) {
      where.status = filters.status;
    }

    if (filters.gender) {
      where.gender = filters.gender;
    }

    // Get total count
    const total = await this.prisma.student.count({ where });

    // Get students
    const students = await this.prisma.student.findMany({
      where,
      skip,
      take: pageSize,
      orderBy: { [sortBy]: sortOrder },
      include: {
        currentClass: {
          select: { id: true, name: true, level: true },
        },
        currentStream: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
        guardianLinks: {
          where: { isPrimary: true },
          take: 1,
          include: {
            guardian: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                phone: true,
                email: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

    return {
      data: students,
      meta: {
        page,
        pageSize,
        total,
        totalPages,
        hasNextPage: page < totalPages,
        hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
      },
    };
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: {
        id,
        tenantId,
        deletedAt: null,
      },
      include: {
        currentClass: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            level: true,
            educationLevel: true,
          },
        },
        currentStream: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            capacity: true,
          },
        },
        guardianLinks: {
          include: {
            guardian: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                firstName: true,
                lastName: true,
                middleName: true,
                phone: true,
                alternatePhone: true,
                email: true,
                occupation: true,
                address: true,
              },
            },
          },
          orderBy: {
            isPrimary: 'desc',
          },
        },
        enrollments: {
          orderBy: {
            createdAt: 'desc',
          },
          take: 5,
          include: {
            class: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
            stream: {
              select: { name: true },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Student with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return student;
  }

  async update(id: string, updateStudentDto: UpdateStudentDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Validate class and stream if provided
    if (updateStudentDto.currentClassId) {
      await this.validateClass(updateStudentDto.currentClassId);
    }

    if (updateStudentDto.currentStreamId) {
      await this.validateStream(updateStudentDto.currentStreamId);
    }

    const student = await this.prisma.student.update({
      where: { id },
      data: updateStudentDto,
      include: {
        currentClass: {
          select: { id: true, name: true, level: true },
        },
        currentStream: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return student;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student exists
    await this.findOne(id);

    // Soft delete
    await this.prisma.student.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        status: 'WITHDRAWN',
      },
    });

    return { message: 'Student deleted successfully' };
  }

  async assignClass(id: string, assignClassDto: AssignClassDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Verify student exists
    const student = await this.findOne(id);

    // Validate class
    await this.validateClass(assignClassDto.classId);

    // Validate stream if provided
    if (assignClassDto.streamId) {
      await this.validateStream(assignClassDto.streamId);

      // Verify stream belongs to class
      const stream = await this.prisma.stream.findUnique({
        where: { id: assignClassDto.streamId },
      });

      if (stream?.classId !== assignClassDto.classId) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Stream does not belong to the specified class');
      }
    }

    // Update student
    const updated = await this.prisma.student.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        currentClassId: assignClassDto.classId,
        currentStreamId: assignClassDto.streamId || null,
      },
      include: {
        currentClass: true,
        currentStream: true,
      },
    });

    // Create enrollment record
    await this.prisma.enrollment.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        studentId: id,
        classId: assignClassDto.classId,
        streamId: assignClassDto.streamId,
        enrollmentDate: new Date(),
      },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  async getGuardians(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const student = await this.prisma.student.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        guardianLinks: {
          include: {
            guardian: true,
          },
          orderBy: {
            isPrimary: 'desc',
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!student) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Student with ID ${id} not found`);
    }

    return student.guardianLinks;
  }

  async getStats() {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const [total, active, graduated, transferred, withdrawn] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'ACTIVE', deletedAt: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'GRADUATED', deletedAt: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'TRANSFERRED', deletedAt: null },
      }),
      this.prisma.student.count({
        where: { tenantId, status: 'WITHDRAWN', deletedAt: null },
      }),
    ]);

    return {
      total,
      active,
      graduated,
      transferred,
      withdrawn,
      byStatus: {
        ACTIVE: active,
        GRADUATED: graduated,
        TRANSFERRED: transferred,
        WITHDRAWN: withdrawn,
      },
    };
  }

  private async validateClass(classId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
      where: { id: classId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!classExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Class with ID ${classId} not found`);
    }

    return classExists;
  }

  private async validateStream(streamId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const streamExists = await this.prisma.stream.findFirst({
      where: { id: streamId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!streamExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Stream with ID ${streamId} not found`);
    }

    return streamExists;
  }
}

import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import {
  IsString,
  IsEnum,
  IsOptional,
  IsBoolean,
  IsInt,
  Min,
  MinLength,
  IsArray,
  IsObject,
} from 'class-validator';
import { BillingCycle } from './subscription.dto';

export class CreatePlanDto {
  @ApiProperty({ description: 'Plan name', example: 'Professional' })
  @IsString()

  name: string;

  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'URL-friendly slug',
    example: 'professional',

      'mpesa',
    ],

  @IsArray()

================
File: apps/api/src/modules/subscriptions/subscriptions.service.ts
================
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ForbiddenException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {
  CreateSubscriptionDto,
  UpdateSubscriptionDto,
  RenewSubscriptionDto,
  CancelSubscriptionDto,
  UpdateUsageDto,
  QuerySubscriptionsDto,
  SubscriptionStatus,
} from './dto/subscription.dto';
import { CreatePlanDto, UpdatePlanDto } from './dto/plan.dto';
import { formatCurrency } from '@krypton/utils';

@Injectable()
export class SubscriptionsService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SubscriptionsService.name);

  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== SUBSCRIPTION MANAGEMENT ====================

  async createSubscription(dto: CreateSubscriptionDto) {
    // Validate tenant exists
    const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({
      where: { id: dto.tenantId },
      include: { subscription: true },
    });

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Tenant not found');
    }

    if (tenant.subscription) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Tenant already has a subscription');
    }

    // Validate plan exists
    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id: dto.planId },
    });

    if (!plan) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Plan not found');
    }

    if (!plan.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Plan is not available');
    }

    // Calculate dates
    const startDate = dto.startDate ? new Date(dto.startDate) : new Date();
    const trialEndsAt = new Date(startDate);
    trialEndsAt.setDate(trialEndsAt.getDate() + plan.trialDays);

    const endDate = new Date(trialEndsAt);
    if (plan.billingCycle === 'ANNUAL') {
      endDate.setFullYear(endDate.getFullYear() + 1);
    } else {
      endDate.setMonth(endDate.getMonth() + 1);
    }

    // Create subscription
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.create({
      data: {
        tenantId: dto.tenantId,
        planId: dto.planId,
        status: SubscriptionStatus.TRIAL,
        startDate,
        endDate,
        trialEndsAt,
        autoRenew: dto.autoRenew !== false,
        paymentMethod: dto.paymentMethod,
        smsCredits: plan.smsCredits,
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            subdomain: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Subscription created for tenant ${tenant.name} (${plan.name} plan)`,
    );

    return subscription;
  }

  async findAll(query: QuerySubscriptionsDto) {
    const where: any = {};

    if (query.status) {
      where.status = query.status;
    }

    if (query.planId) {
      where.planId = query.planId;
    }

    if (!query.includeExpired) {
      where.status = { not: SubscriptionStatus.EXPIRED };
    }

    const subscriptions = await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            subdomain: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    return subscriptions;
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            subdomain: true,
            contactEmail: true,
            contactPhone: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    return subscription;
  }

  async findByTenant(tenantId: string) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: {
        plan: true,
      },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No subscription found for this tenant');
    }

    return subscription;
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateSubscriptionDto) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    // If changing plan (upgrade/downgrade)
    if (dto.planId && dto.planId !== existing.planId) {
      return this.changePlan(id, dto.planId);
    }

    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.autoRenew !== undefined && { autoRenew: dto.autoRenew }),
        ...(dto.paymentMethod && { paymentMethod: dto.paymentMethod }),
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: { id: true, name: true, subdomain: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return subscription;
  }

  async changePlan(subscriptionId: string, newPlanId: string) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id: subscriptionId },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    const newPlan = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id: newPlanId },
    });

    if (!newPlan) {
      throw new NotFoundException('New plan not found');
    }

    if (!newPlan.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException('New plan is not available');
    }

    // Calculate proration if mid-cycle
    const now = new Date();
    const isUpgrade = newPlan.price > subscription.plan.price;

    // Update subscription
    const updated = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id: subscriptionId },
      data: {
        planId: newPlanId,
        smsCredits: newPlan.smsCredits, // Reset SMS credits on plan change
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Subscription ${subscriptionId} changed from ${subscription.plan.name} to ${newPlan.name}`,
    );

    return {
      subscription: updated,
      isUpgrade,
      priceDifference: newPlan.price - subscription.plan.price,
    };
  }

  async renew(id: string, dto: RenewSubscriptionDto) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    // Calculate new end date
    const currentEnd = new Date(subscription.endDate);
    const newEndDate = new Date(currentEnd);

    if (subscription.plan.billingCycle === 'ANNUAL') {
      newEndDate.setFullYear(newEndDate.getFullYear() + 1);
    } else {
      newEndDate.setMonth(newEndDate.getMonth() + 1);
    }

    const paymentDate = dto.paymentDate
      ? new Date(dto.paymentDate)
      : new Date();

    // Update subscription
    const renewed = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE,
        endDate: newEndDate,
        lastPaymentDate: paymentDate,
        nextPaymentDate: newEndDate,
        smsCredits: { increment: subscription.plan.smsCredits }, // Add monthly credits
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Subscription ${id} renewed until ${newEndDate.toISOString()}`,
    );

    return renewed;
  }

  async cancel(id: string, dto: CancelSubscriptionDto) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subscription not found');
    }

    if (subscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.CANCELLED) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Subscription is already cancelled');
    }

    const cancelDate = dto.immediate ? new Date() : subscription.endDate;

    const cancelled = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: SubscriptionStatus.CANCELLED,
        autoRenew: false,
        ...(dto.immediate && { endDate: cancelDate }),
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: { id: true, name: true },
        },
      },
    });

    this.logger.log(
      `Subscription ${id} cancelled. Reason: ${dto.reason}. Immediate: ${dto.immediate}`,
    );

    return {
      subscription: cancelled,
      effectiveDate: cancelDate,
      reason: dto.reason,
    };
  }

  async updateUsage(tenantId: string, dto: UpdateUsageDto) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No subscription found for this tenant');
    }

    // Check limits
    if (dto.studentCount && dto.studentCount > subscription.plan.maxStudents) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Student count ${dto.studentCount} exceeds plan limit of ${subscription.plan.maxStudents}`,
      );
    }

    if (dto.staffCount && dto.staffCount > subscription.plan.maxStaff) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Staff count ${dto.staffCount} exceeds plan limit of ${subscription.plan.maxStaff}`,
      );
    }

    if (dto.storageUsedMB && dto.storageUsedMB > subscription.plan.maxStorageMB) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Storage usage ${dto.storageUsedMB}MB exceeds plan limit of ${subscription.plan.maxStorageMB}MB`,
      );
    }

    const updated = await this.prisma.subscription.update({
      where: { tenantId },
      data: {
        ...(dto.studentCount !== undefined && {
          studentCount: dto.studentCount,
        }),
        ...(dto.staffCount !== undefined && { staffCount: dto.staffCount }),
        ...(dto.storageUsedMB !== undefined && {
          storageUsedMB: dto.storageUsedMB,
        }),
        ...(dto.smsCredits !== undefined && { smsCredits: dto.smsCredits }),
      },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  async checkLimits(tenantId: string) {
    const subscription = await this.prisma.subscription.findUnique({
      where: { tenantId },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    if (!subscription) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No subscription found for this tenant');
    }

    const withinLimits = {
      students:
        subscription.studentCount <= subscription.plan.maxStudents,
      staff: subscription.staffCount <= subscription.plan.maxStaff,
      storage:
        subscription.storageUsedMB <= subscription.plan.maxStorageMB,
      sms: subscription.smsCredits > 0,
    };

    const allWithinLimits = Object.values(withinLimits).every((v) => v);

    return {
      withinLimits: allWithinLimits,
      details: {
        students: {
          used: subscription.studentCount,
          limit: subscription.plan.maxStudents,
          withinLimit: withinLimits.students,
          percentUsed: Math.round(
            (subscription.studentCount / subscription.plan.maxStudents) * 100,
          ),
        },
        staff: {
          used: subscription.staffCount,
          limit: subscription.plan.maxStaff,
          withinLimit: withinLimits.staff,
          percentUsed: Math.round(
            (subscription.staffCount / subscription.plan.maxStaff) * 100,
          ),
        },
        storage: {
          used: subscription.storageUsedMB,
          limit: subscription.plan.maxStorageMB,
          withinLimit: withinLimits.storage,
          percentUsed: Math.round(
            (subscription.storageUsedMB / subscription.plan.maxStorageMB) * 100,
          ),
        },
        sms: {
          remaining: subscription.smsCredits,
          withinLimit: withinLimits.sms,
        },
      },
    };
  }

  async checkExpiring(days: number = 30) {
    const futureDate = new Date();
    futureDate.setDate(futureDate.getDate() + days);

    const expiring = await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({
      where: {
        status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.TRIAL, SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE] },
        endDate: {
          lte: futureDate,
        },
      },
      include: {
        plan: true,
        tenant: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            contactEmail: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { endDate: 'asc' },
    });

    return expiring;
  }

  async processExpiredSubscriptions() {
    const now = new Date();

    const expired = await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({
      where: {
        status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.TRIAL, SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE] },
        endDate: { lte: now },
      },
    });

    const results = {
      processed: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    for (const subscription of expired) {
      try {
        await this.prisma.subscription.update({
          where: { id: subscription.id },
          data: { status: SubscriptionStatus.EXPIRED },
        });
        results.processed++;
      } catch (error) {
        results.errors.push({
          subscriptionId: subscription.id,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    this.logger.log(
      `Processed ${results.processed} expired subscriptions`,
    );

    return results;
  }

  // ==================== PLAN MANAGEMENT ====================

  async createPlan(dto: CreatePlanDto) {
    // Check if slug already exists
    const existing = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { slug: dto.slug },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Plan slug already exists');
    }

    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.create({
      data: {
        name: dto.name,
        slug: dto.slug,
        description: dto.description,
        price: dto.price,
        billingCycle: dto.billingCycle || 'ANNUAL',
        trialDays: dto.trialDays || 14,
        maxStudents: dto.maxStudents,
        maxStaff: dto.maxStaff,
        maxStorageMB: dto.maxStorageMB || 10000,
        smsCredits: dto.smsCredits || 1000,
        features: dto.features,
        sortOrder: dto.sortOrder || 0,
      },
    });

    return plan;
  }

  async findAllPlans(activeOnly: boolean = false) {
    const where: any = {};

    if (activeOnly) {
      where.isActive = true;
    }

    const plans = await this.prisma.plan.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: [{ sortOrder: 'asc' }, { price: 'asc' }],
      include: {
        _count: {
          select: { subscriptions: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return plans;
  }

  async findOnePlan(id: string) {
    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        _count: {
          select: { subscriptions: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!plan) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Plan not found');
    }

    return plan;
  }

  async updatePlan(id: string, dto: UpdatePlanDto) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Plan not found');
    }

    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.update({
      where: { id },
      data: dto,
    });

    return plan;
  }

  async deletePlan(id: string) {
    const plan = await this.prisma.plan.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        _count: {
          select: { subscriptions: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!plan) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Plan not found');
    }

    if (plan._count.subscriptions > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Cannot delete plan with active subscriptions. Deactivate it instead.',
      );
    }

    await this.prisma.plan.delete({ where: { id } });

    return { success: true, message: 'Plan deleted' };
  }

  async getSubscriptionStats() {
    const [total, active, trial, expired, cancelled] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.subscription.count(),
      this.prisma.subscription.count({
        where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE },
      }),
      this.prisma.subscription.count({
        where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.TRIAL },
      }),
      this.prisma.subscription.count({
        where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.EXPIRED },
      }),
      this.prisma.subscription.count({
        where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.CANCELLED },
      }),
    ]);

    // Calculate MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue)
    const activeSubscriptions = await this.prisma.subscription.findMany({
      where: { status: SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    let mrr = 0;
    for (const sub of activeSubscriptions) {
      if (sub.plan.billingCycle === 'ANNUAL') {
        mrr += sub.plan.price / 12; // Convert annual to monthly
      } else {
        mrr += sub.plan.price;
      }
    }

    return {
      total,
      active,
      trial,
      expired,
      cancelled,
      mrr: Math.round(mrr), // in minor units
      mrrFormatted: formatCurrency(mrr),
    };
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma.service';
import { TenantService } from '../../database/tenant.service';
import {
  CreateTimetableEntryDto,
  UpdateTimetableEntryDto,
  BulkCreateTimetableDto,
  QueryTimetableDto,
} from './dto/create-timetable-entry.dto';
import {
  CreateSchoolEventDto,
  UpdateSchoolEventDto,
  QuerySchoolEventsDto,
} from './dto/create-school-event.dto';

@Injectable()
export class TimetableService {
  constructor(
    private prisma: PrismaService,
    private tenantService: TenantService,
  ) {}

  // ==================== TIMETABLE ENTRIES ====================

  async createEntry(dto: CreateTimetableEntryDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate class exists
    const classExists = await this.prisma.class.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.classId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!classExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Class not found');
    }

    // Validate stream if provided
    if (dto.streamId) {
      const streamExists = await this.prisma.stream.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.streamId, tenantId, classId: dto.classId },
      });

      if (!streamExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Stream not found or does not belong to class');
      }
    }

    // Validate subject exists
    const subjectExists = await this.prisma.subject.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.subjectId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!subjectExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Subject not found');
    }

    // Validate teacher exists
    const teacherExists = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.teacherId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!teacherExists) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Teacher not found');
    }

    // Validate time order
    if (dto.startTime >= dto.endTime) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Start time must be before end time');
    }

    // Check for conflicts
    await this.checkConflicts(
      dto.classId,
      dto.streamId,
      dto.teacherId,
      dto.dayOfWeek,
      dto.period,
      dto.startTime,
      dto.endTime,
      dto.room,
    );

    // Create entry
    const entry = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        classId: dto.classId,
        streamId: dto.streamId,
        subjectId: dto.subjectId,
        teacherId: dto.teacherId,
        dayOfWeek: dto.dayOfWeek,
        period: dto.period,
        startTime: dto.startTime,
        endTime: dto.endTime,
        room: dto.room,
      },
      include: {
        class: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        stream: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        subject: {
          select: { name: true, code: true },
        },
        teacher: {
          select: { firstName: true, lastName: true },
        },
      },
    });

    return entry;
  }

  async bulkCreate(dto: BulkCreateTimetableDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const results = {
      success: 0,
      failed: 0,
      errors: [] as any[],
    };

    for (const entryDto of dto.entries) {
      try {
        await this.createEntry(entryDto);
        results.success++;
      } catch (error) {
        results.failed++;
        results.errors.push({
          entry: entryDto,
          error: error.message,
        });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  async findAll(query: QueryTimetableDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (query.classId) where.classId = query.classId;
    if (query.streamId) where.streamId = query.streamId;
    if (query.teacherId) where.teacherId = query.teacherId;
    if (query.dayOfWeek) where.dayOfWeek = query.dayOfWeek;

    const entries = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        class: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        stream: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        subject: {
          select: { name: true, code: true },
        },
        teacher: {
          select: { firstName: true, lastName: true },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [{ dayOfWeek: 'asc' }, { startTime: 'asc' }],
    });

    return entries;
  }

  async findOne(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const entry = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      include: {
        class: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        stream: {
          select: { name: true },
        },
        subject: {
          select: { name: true, code: true },
        },
        teacher: {
          select: { firstName: true, lastName: true, email: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!entry) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Timetable entry not found');
    }

    return entry;
  }

  async update(id: string, dto: UpdateTimetableEntryDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const existing = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Timetable entry not found');
    }

    // Validate subject if changed
    if (dto.subjectId) {
      const subjectExists = await this.prisma.subject.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.subjectId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!subjectExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Subject not found');
      }
    }

    // Validate teacher if changed
    if (dto.teacherId) {
      const teacherExists = await this.prisma.staff.findFirst({
        where: { id: dto.teacherId, tenantId },
      });

      if (!teacherExists) {
        throw new NotFoundException('Teacher not found');
      }
    }

    // Validate time order if times are being updated
    const startTime = dto.startTime || existing.startTime;
    const endTime = dto.endTime || existing.endTime;

    if (startTime >= endTime) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Start time must be before end time');
    }

    // Check for conflicts if relevant fields changed
    if (dto.teacherId || dto.startTime || dto.endTime || dto.room) {
      await this.checkConflicts(
        existing.classId,
        existing.streamId,
        dto.teacherId || existing.teacherId,
        existing.dayOfWeek,
        existing.period,
        startTime,
        endTime,
        dto.room || existing.room,
        id, // Exclude current entry
      );
    }

    const entry = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.update({
      where: { id },
      data: dto,
      include: {
        class: { select: { name: true } },
        stream: { select: { name: true } },
        subject: { select: { name: true, code: true } },
        teacher: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
      },
    });

    return entry;
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const entry = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!entry) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Timetable entry not found');
    }

    await this.prisma.timetableEntry.delete({ where: { id } });

    return { success: true, message: 'Timetable entry deleted' };
  }

  async getClassTimetable(classId: string, streamId?: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = {
      tenantId,
      classId,
    };

    if (streamId) {
      where.streamId = streamId;
    }

    const entries = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        subject: { select: { name: true, code: true } },
        teacher: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
      },
      orderBy: [{ dayOfWeek: 'asc' }, { startTime: 'asc' }],
    });

    // Group by day of week
    const timetable = this.groupByDay(entries);

    return timetable;
  }

  async getTeacherTimetable(teacherId: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const entries = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where: { tenantId, teacherId },
      include: {
        class: { select: { name: true } },
        stream: { select: { name: true } },
        subject: { select: { name: true, code: true } },
      },
      orderBy: [{ dayOfWeek: 'asc' }, { startTime: 'asc' }],
    });

    const timetable = this.groupByDay(entries);

    return timetable;
  }

  private groupByDay(entries: any[]) {
    const days = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];
    
    const grouped = {};

    for (let i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
      grouped[days[i - 1]] = entries.filter((e) => e.dayOfWeek === i);
    }

    return grouped;
  }

  private async checkConflicts(
    classId: string,
    streamId: string | undefined,
    teacherId: string,
    dayOfWeek: number,
    period: string,
    startTime: string,
    endTime: string,
    room: string | undefined,
    excludeId?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Check class/stream conflict (same period, same day)
    const classConflict = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findFirst({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        classId,
        ...(streamId && { streamId }),
        dayOfWeek,
        period,
        ...(excludeId && { id: { not: excludeId } }),
      },
    });

    if (classConflict) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `Class/Stream already has another subject scheduled for this period`,
      );
    }

    // Check teacher conflict (overlapping time slots)
    const teacherConflicts = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        teacherId,
        dayOfWeek,
        ...(excludeId && { id: { not: excludeId } }),
      },
    });

    for (const conflict of teacherConflicts) {
      if (this.timesOverlap(startTime, endTime, conflict.startTime, conflict.endTime)) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          `Teacher already has a class scheduled during this time (${conflict.startTime} - ${conflict.endTime})`,
        );
      }
    }

    // Check room conflict if room is specified
    if (room) {
      const roomConflicts = await this.prisma.timetableEntry.findMany({
        where: {
          tenantId,
          room,
          dayOfWeek,
          ...(excludeId && { id: { not: excludeId } }),
        },
      });

      for (const conflict of roomConflicts) {
        if (this.timesOverlap(startTime, endTime, conflict.startTime, conflict.endTime)) {
          throw new ConflictException(
            `Room ${room} is already booked during this time (${conflict.startTime} - ${conflict.endTime})`,
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private timesOverlap(
    start1: string,
    end1: string,
    start2: string,
    end2: string,
  ): boolean {
    // Convert HH:MM to minutes for comparison
    const toMinutes = (time: string) => {
      const [hours, minutes] = time.split(':').map(Number);
      return hours * 60 + minutes;
    };

    const s1 = toMinutes(start1);
    const e1 = toMinutes(end1);
    const s2 = toMinutes(start2);
    const e2 = toMinutes(end2);

    // Check if intervals overlap
    return s1 < e2 && s2 < e1;
  }

  // ==================== SCHOOL CALENDAR / EVENTS ====================

  async createEvent(dto: CreateSchoolEventDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    // Validate dates
    const startDate = new Date(dto.startDate);
    const endDate = new Date(dto.endDate);

    if (startDate > endDate) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Start date must be before or equal to end date');
    }

    const event = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.create({
      data: {
        tenantId,
        title: dto.title,
        description: dto.description,
        eventType: dto.eventType,
        category: dto.category,
        startDate,
        endDate,
        isAllDay: dto.isAllDay !== false,
        startTime: dto.startTime,
        endTime: dto.endTime,
        location: dto.location,
        isHoliday: dto.isHoliday || false,
      },
    });

    return event;
  }

  async findAllEvents(query: QuerySchoolEventsDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const where: any = { tenantId };

    if (query.startDate) {
      where.startDate = { gte: new Date(query.startDate) };
    }

    if (query.endDate) {
      where.endDate = { lte: new Date(query.endDate) };
    }

    if (query.eventType) {
      where.eventType = query.eventType;
    }

    if (query.category) {
      where.category = query.category;
    }

    if (query.holidaysOnly) {
      where.isHoliday = true;
    }

    const events = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
    });

    return events;
  }

  async findOneEvent(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const event = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!event) {
      throw new NotFoundException('School event not found');
    }

    return event;
  }

  async updateEvent(id: string, dto: UpdateSchoolEventDto) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const existing = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new NotFoundException('School event not found');
    }

    // Validate dates if both are being updated
    if (dto.startDate && dto.endDate) {
      const startDate = new Date(dto.startDate);
      const endDate = new Date(dto.endDate);

      if (startDate > endDate) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Start date must be before or equal to end date');
      }
    }

    const event = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...(dto.title && { title: dto.title }),
        ...(dto.description !== undefined && { description: dto.description }),
        ...(dto.eventType && { eventType: dto.eventType }),
        ...(dto.category && { category: dto.category }),
        ...(dto.startDate && { startDate: new Date(dto.startDate) }),
        ...(dto.endDate && { endDate: new Date(dto.endDate) }),
        ...(dto.isAllDay !== undefined && { isAllDay: dto.isAllDay }),
        ...(dto.startTime !== undefined && { startTime: dto.startTime }),
        ...(dto.endTime !== undefined && { endTime: dto.endTime }),
        ...(dto.location !== undefined && { location: dto.location }),
        ...(dto.isHoliday !== undefined && { isHoliday: dto.isHoliday }),
      },
    });

    return event;
  }

  async removeEvent(id: string) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const event = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findFirst({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!event) {
      throw new NotFoundException('School event not found');
    }

    await this.prisma.schoolEvent.delete({ where: { id } });

    return { success: true, message: 'School event deleted' };
  }

  async getUpcomingEvents(days: number = 30) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const today = new Date();
    const futureDate = new Date();
    futureDate.setDate(today.getDate() + days);

    const events = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        startDate: {
          gte: today,
          lte: futureDate,
        },
      },
      orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
    });

    return events;
  }

  async getHolidays(year?: number) {
    const tenantId = this.tenantService.requireTenantContext();

    const currentYear = year || new Date().getFullYear();
    const startDate = new Date(`${currentYear}-01-01`);
    const endDate = new Date(`${currentYear}-12-31`);

    const holidays = await this.prisma.schoolEvent.findMany({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        isHoliday: true,
        startDate: { gte: startDate },
        endDate: { lte: endDate },
      },
      orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
    });

    return holidays;
  }
}

// Service Worker for Krypton School ERP Parent Portal
const CACHE_VERSION = 'v1.0.0';
const CACHE_NAME = `krypton-parent-portal-${CACHE_VERSION}`;

// Assets to cache on install
const STATIC_CACHE_URLS = [
  '/',
  '/login',
  '/dashboard',
  '/manifest.json',
  '/icon-192.png',
  '/icon-512.png',
];

// API routes that should be cached with network-first strategy
const API_CACHE_PATTERNS = [
  /\/api\/v1\/students\/my-children/,
  /\/api\/v1\/attendance/,
  /\/api\/v1\/fees/,
  /\/api\/v1\/examinations/,
];

// Install event - cache static assets
self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  console.log('[ServiceWorker] Install');
  
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
      console.log('[ServiceWorker] Caching static assets');
      return cache.addAll(STATIC_CACHE_URLS).catch((err) => {
        console.error('[ServiceWorker] Cache addAll error:', err);
      });
    })
  );
  
  // Force the waiting service worker to become the active service worker
  self.skipWaiting();
});

// Activate event - clean up old caches
self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  console.log('[ServiceWorker] Activate');
  
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((cacheNames) => {
      return Promise.all(
        cacheNames.map((cacheName) => {
          if (cacheName !== CACHE_NAME) {
            console.log('[ServiceWorker] Deleting old cache:', cacheName);
            return caches.delete(cacheName);
          }
        })
      );
    })
  );
  
  // Take control of all pages immediately
  return self.clients.claim();
});

// Fetch event - serve from cache, fallback to network
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  const { request } = event;
  const url = new URL(request.url);

  // Skip cross-origin requests
  if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) {
    return;
  }

  // Handle API requests with network-first strategy
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) {
    event.respondWith(networkFirstStrategy(request));
    return;
  }

  // Handle navigation requests
  if (request.mode === 'navigate') {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(request).catch(() => {
        return caches.match('/').then((response) => {
          return response || new Response('Offline - Please check your connection', {
            status: 503,
            statusText: 'Service Unavailable',
          });
        });
      })
    );
    return;
  }

  // Handle all other requests with cache-first strategy
  event.respondWith(cacheFirstStrategy(request));
});

// Cache-first strategy: Try cache first, fallback to network
async function cacheFirstStrategy(request) {
  const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_NAME);
  const cached = await cache.match(request);

  if (cached) {
    // Return cached version and update cache in background
    updateCache(request, cache);
    return cached;
  }

  try {
    const response = await fetch(request);
    if (response.ok) {
      cache.put(request, response.clone());
    }
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ServiceWorker] Fetch error:', error);
    return new Response('Network error', {
      status: 408,
      statusText: 'Request Timeout',
    });
  }
}

// Network-first strategy: Try network first, fallback to cache
async function networkFirstStrategy(request) {
  const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_NAME);

  try {
    const response = await fetch(request);
    
    if (response.ok) {
      // Cache successful API responses for offline use
      cache.put(request, response.clone());
    }
    
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('[ServiceWorker] Network failed, trying cache:', request.url);
    
    const cached = await cache.match(request);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        error: 'Offline',
        message: 'No internet connection. Please try again when online.',
      }),
      {
        status: 503,
        statusText: 'Service Unavailable',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      }
    );
  }
}

// Update cache in background
async function updateCache(request, cache) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(request);
    if (response.ok) {
      cache.put(request, response.clone());
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // Silently fail - we already have cached version
  }
}

// Listen for messages from clients
self.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
  if (event.data && event.data.type === 'SKIP_WAITING') {
    self.skipWaiting();
  }

  if (event.data && event.data.type === 'CACHE_URLS') {
    event.waitUntil(
      caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {
        return cache.addAll(event.data.urls);
      })
    );
  }
});

// Background sync for offline payment submissions
self.addEventListener('sync', (event) => {
  if (event.tag === 'sync-payments') {
    event.waitUntil(syncPayments());
  }
});

async function syncPayments() {
  // This would sync any pending payments when connection is restored
  console.log('[ServiceWorker] Syncing pending payments');
  
  // Get pending payments from IndexedDB and retry submission
  // Implementation depends on your offline storage strategy
}

// Push notification support
self.addEventListener('push', (event) => {
  if (!event.data) return;

  const data = event.data.json();
  const title = data.title || 'Krypton School';
  const options = {
    body: data.body || 'You have a new notification',
    icon: '/icon-192.png',
    badge: '/icon-192.png',
    data: data.url || '/',
    actions: [
      { action: 'open', title: 'View' },
      { action: 'close', title: 'Dismiss' },
    ],
  };

  event.waitUntil(self.registration.showNotification(title, options));
});

// Handle notification clicks
self.addEventListener('notificationclick', (event) => {
  event.notification.close();

  if (event.action === 'close') {
    return;
  }

  const urlToOpen = event.notification.data || '/';

  event.waitUntil(
    clients.matchAll({ type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true }).then((clientList) => {
      // Check if there's already a window open
      for (const client of clientList) {
        if (client.url === urlToOpen && 'focus' in client) {
          return client.focus();
        }
      }
      
      // Open new window if none exists
      if (clients.openWindow) {
        return clients.openWindow(urlToOpen);
      }
    })
  );
});

# Krypton School ERP - Parent Portal

A Progressive Web App (PWA) for parents to access their children's school information, pay fees, view grades, and track attendance.

## Features

### ✅ Completed Features

#### Authentication
- [x] Login with email/password
- [x] JWT token-based authentication
- [x] Automatic token refresh
- [x] Protected routes with role-based access control
- [x] Logout functionality

#### Dashboard
- [x] Overview of fee balance, attendance rate, and recent grades
- [x] Quick actions for common tasks
- [x] Student selector for parents with multiple children
- [x] Real-time data updates

#### Fee Management
- [x] View outstanding invoices
- [x] Payment history
- [x] M-Pesa STK Push integration
- [x] Pay fees directly from phone
- [x] Downloadable receipts
- [x] Fee balance tracking
- [x] Invoice details

#### Attendance
- [x] Calendar view of attendance
- [x] Monthly navigation
- [x] Status indicators (Present, Absent, Late, Excused)
- [x] Attendance statistics
- [x] Detailed records

#### Grades & Report Cards
- [x] View grades by term
- [x] Report card viewing
- [x] Performance statistics
- [x] Subject-wise grades
- [x] Teacher and principal comments
- [x] Download report cards (PDF ready)

#### Notifications
- [x] Fee reminders
- [x] Absence alerts
- [x] Payment receipts
- [x] Exam schedules
- [x] General announcements
- [x] Read/unread status
- [x] Priority indicators

#### PWA Features
- [x] Installable as native app
- [x] Offline support with service worker
- [x] Caching strategy (cache-first for static, network-first for API)
- [x] Background sync for offline actions
- [x] Push notifications support
- [x] App update prompts
- [x] Offline indicator
- [x] Install prompt

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **State Management:** React Context + Zustand
- **API Client:** Axios
- **Date Utilities:** date-fns
- **Icons:** Lucide React
- **PWA:** Custom service worker

## API Integration

The parent portal connects to the Krypton School ERP backend API:

### Endpoints Used

- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` - User authentication
- `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` - Token refresh
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` - User logout
- `GET /api/v1/students/my-children` - Get linked children
- `GET /api/v1/students/:id` - Get student details
- `GET /api/v1/fees/invoices` - Get invoices
- `GET /api/v1/fees/payments` - Get payments
- `POST /api/v1/mpesa/stk-push` - Initiate M-Pesa payment
- `GET /api/v1/attendance/students` - Get attendance
- `GET /api/v1/attendance/students/report` - Get attendance summary
- `GET /api/v1/examinations/grades/query` - Get grades
- `GET /api/v1/examinations/report-cards` - Get report cards

### API Client Features

- Automatic JWT token injection
- Token refresh on 401 errors
- Request/response interceptors
- Error handling
- Retry logic

## PWA Features

### Service Worker

The app includes a custom service worker (`public/sw.js`) that provides:

- **Caching Strategies:**
  - Static assets: Cache-first
  - API requests: Network-first with cache fallback
  - Navigation requests: Network with offline fallback

- **Offline Support:**
  - Cached API responses available offline
  - Graceful degradation
  - Offline indicator

- **Background Sync:**
  - Queue failed requests
  - Retry when connection restored

- **Push Notifications:**
  - Fee reminders
  - Absence alerts
  - Payment confirmations

### Installation

The app can be installed on:
- Android (Chrome, Edge, Samsung Internet)
- iOS (Safari 16.4+)
- Desktop (Chrome, Edge)

### Offline Capabilities

When offline, users can:
- ✅ View cached dashboard data
- ✅ View cached attendance records
- ✅ View cached grades
- ✅ View cached invoices
- ❌ Make M-Pesa payments (requires online)
- ❌ Load new data (requires online)

## Troubleshooting

### Service Worker Not Registering

1. Check HTTPS (required for PWA)
2. Clear browser cache
3. Check console for errors
4. Verify `sw.js` is accessible

### Offline Mode Not Working

1. Check service worker status
2. Verify cache is populated
3. Test network throttling
4. Check cache strategies

### M-Pesa Payment Issues

1. Verify API endpoint is correct
2. Check phone number format (254XXXXXXXXX)
3. Ensure M-Pesa credentials configured
4. Test with small amount first

### Authentication Issues

1. Check token expiry
2. Verify refresh token works
3. Clear localStorage
4. Re-login

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, Button, Badge, LoadingSpinner, Alert } from '@/components/ui';

interface PlatformMetrics {
  totalSchools: number;
  activeSchools: number;
  suspendedSchools: number;
  trialSchools: number;
  totalStudents: number;
  totalStaff: number;
  activeSubscriptions: number;
  expiringSubscriptions: number;
  mrr: number; // Monthly Recurring Revenue
  arr: number; // Annual Recurring Revenue
  totalRevenue: number;
  pendingPayments: number;
}

interface SystemHealth {
  status: 'healthy' | 'warning' | 'critical';
  uptime: number;
  apiResponseTime: number;
  databaseStatus: 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'down';
  storageUsed: number;
  storageTotal: number;
  activeUsers: number;
  errorRate: number;
}

interface RecentActivity {
  id: string;
  type: 'SCHOOL_CREATED' | 'SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWED' | 'PAYMENT_RECEIVED' | 'USER_CREATED' | 'SYSTEM_ALERT';
  title: string;
  description: string;
  timestamp: string;
  severity: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';
}

interface Alert {
  id: string;
  type: 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRING' | 'PAYMENT_FAILED' | 'SYSTEM_ERROR' | 'SUPPORT_TICKET';
  message: string;
  count: number;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

export default function AdminDashboardPage() {
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<PlatformMetrics | null>(null);
  const [systemHealth, setSystemHealth] = useState<SystemHealth | null>(null);
  const [recentActivities, setRecentActivities] = useState<RecentActivity[]>([]);
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<Alert[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<'today' | 'week' | 'month'>('month');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDashboardData();
    
    // Refresh data every 30 seconds
    const interval = setInterval(fetchDashboardData, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [timeRange]);

  const fetchDashboardData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');

      const [metricsRes, healthRes, activitiesRes, alertsRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`http://localhost:3001/api/admin/metrics?range=${timeRange}`, {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
        }),
        fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/system-health', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
        }),
        fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/activities?limit=10', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
        }),
        fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/alerts', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
        }),
      ]);

      if (!metricsRes.ok || !healthRes.ok || !activitiesRes.ok || !alertsRes.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to fetch dashboard data');
      }

      const [metricsData, healthData, activitiesData, alertsData] = await Promise.all([
        metricsRes.json(),
        healthRes.json(),
        activitiesRes.json(),
        alertsRes.json(),
      ]);

      setMetrics(metricsData);
      setSystemHealth(healthData);
      setRecentActivities(activitiesData);
      setAlerts(alertsData);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to load dashboard data');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatCurrency = (amount: number) => {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'KES',
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(amount / 100); // Convert from cents
  };

  const formatTimestamp = (timestamp: string) => {
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
    const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);

    if (diffMins < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}m ago`;
    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
    return date.toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const getActivityIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'SCHOOL_CREATED':
        return '🏫';
      case 'SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWED':
        return '🔄';
      case 'PAYMENT_RECEIVED':
        return '💰';
      case 'USER_CREATED':
        return '👤';
      case 'SYSTEM_ALERT':
        return '⚠️';
      default:
        return '📌';
    }
  };

  const getHealthStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'healthy':
        return 'text-green-600 bg-green-100';
      case 'warning':
        return 'text-yellow-600 bg-yellow-100';
      case 'critical':
        return 'text-red-600 bg-red-100';
      default:
        return 'text-gray-600 bg-gray-100';
    }
  };

  const getPriorityBadge = (priority: string): 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'default' => {
    switch (priority) {
      case 'critical':
        return 'danger';
      case 'high':
        return 'danger';
      case 'medium':
        return 'warning';
      default:
        return 'default';
    }
  };

  if (loading && !metrics) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <LoadingSpinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 pb-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="mb-6">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">Platform Dashboard</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 mt-1">KryptonLogic School ERP - System Overview</p>
        </div>

        {/* Alerts Section */}
        {alerts.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mb-6 space-y-3">
            {alerts.map((alert) => (
              <Alert
                key={alert.id}
                variant={alert.priority === 'critical' || alert.priority === 'high' ? 'danger' : 'warning'}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                    <Badge variant={getPriorityBadge(alert.priority)}>
                      {alert.priority.toUpperCase()}
                    </Badge>
                    <span className="font-medium">{alert.message}</span>
                    {alert.count > 1 && (
                      <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">({alert.count} items)</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                    View Details
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </Alert>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Time Range Filter */}
        <div className="flex justify-end mb-6">
          <div className="flex space-x-2">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant={timeRange === 'today' ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setTimeRange('today')}
            >
              Today
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant={timeRange === 'week' ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setTimeRange('week')}
            >
              This Week
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant={timeRange === 'month' ? 'primary' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setTimeRange('month')}
            >
              This Month
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Key Metrics Grid */}
        {metrics && (
          <>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 mb-8">
              {/* Schools */}
              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Total Schools</div>
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">{metrics.totalSchools}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-green-600 mt-1">
                  {metrics.activeSchools} active
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Trial Schools</div>
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-yellow-600">{metrics.trialSchools}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  Free trial period
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Students</div>
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-blue-600">{metrics.totalStudents.toLocaleString()}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  Across all schools
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Staff</div>
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-purple-600">{metrics.totalStaff.toLocaleString()}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  All school staff
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Subscriptions</div>
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-600">{metrics.activeSubscriptions}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-orange-600 mt-1">
                  {metrics.expiringSubscriptions} expiring soon
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Suspended</div>
                <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-red-600">{metrics.suspendedSchools}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  Payment overdue
                </div>
              </Card>
            </div>

            {/* Revenue Metrics */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8">
              <Card>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2">Monthly Recurring Revenue</div>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{formatCurrency(metrics.mrr)}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-green-600 mt-1">
                  ↑ 12% from last month
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2">Annual Recurring Revenue</div>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{formatCurrency(metrics.arr)}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-green-600 mt-1">
                  ↑ 8% from last year
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2">Total Revenue ({timeRange})</div>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{formatCurrency(metrics.totalRevenue)}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                  Collected payments
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-2">Pending Payments</div>

        {/* System Health & Recent Activities */}

                  View Detailed Metrics →
                </Button>

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter, usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { AdminNav } from '@/components/AdminNav';

export default function AdminLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Skip auth check for login page
    if (pathname === '/admin/login') {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    // Check authentication
    const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
    const userStr = localStorage.getItem('adminUser');

    if (!token || !userStr) {
      router.push('/admin/login');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const user = JSON.parse(userStr);
      
      // Verify SUPER_ADMIN role
      if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
        localStorage.removeItem('adminToken');
        localStorage.removeItem('adminUser');
        router.push('/admin/login');
        return;
      }

      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      setLoading(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Auth check failed:', error);
      router.push('/admin/login');
    }
  }, [pathname, router]);

  // Show loading state
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-purple-600 mx-auto"></div>
          <p className="mt-4 text-gray-600">Verifying access...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Login page doesn't need navigation
  if (pathname === '/admin/login') {
    return children;
  }

  // Render admin dashboard with navigation
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100">
      <AdminNav />
      <main>{children}</main>
    </div>
  );
}
