'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, Button, Badge, LoadingSpinner, Alert } from '@/components/ui';

interface SystemMetrics {
  uptime: number;
  apiResponseTime: number;
  databaseResponseTime: number;
  activeConnections: number;
  requestsPerMinute: number;
  errorRate: number;
  cpuUsage: number;
  memoryUsage: number;
  diskUsage: number;
  networkIn: number;
  networkOut: number;
}

interface ServiceHealth {
  name: string;
  status: 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'down';
  responseTime: number;
  lastChecked: string;
  uptime: number;
}

interface ErrorLog {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  level: 'ERROR' | 'WARN' | 'CRITICAL';
  message: string;
  service: string;
  count: number;
}

interface BackupInfo {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  size: number;
  status: 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED' | 'IN_PROGRESS';
  duration: number;
  type: 'FULL' | 'INCREMENTAL';
}

export default function SystemPage() {
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<SystemMetrics | null>(null);
  const [services, setServices] = useState<ServiceHealth[]>([]);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<ErrorLog[]>([]);
  const [backups, setBackups] = useState<BackupInfo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSystemData();

    if (autoRefresh) {
      const interval = setInterval(fetchSystemData, 10000); // Refresh every 10 seconds
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, [autoRefresh]);

  const fetchSystemData = async () => {
    try {
      if (loading) setLoading(true);
      const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');

      const [metricsRes, servicesRes, errorsRes, backupsRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/system/metrics', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
        }),
        fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/system/services', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
        }),
        fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/system/errors?limit=10', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
        }),
        fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/system/backups?limit=5', {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
        }),
      ]);

      if (!metricsRes.ok || !servicesRes.ok || !errorsRes.ok || !backupsRes.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to fetch system data');
      }

      const [metricsData, servicesData, errorsData, backupsData] = await Promise.all([
        metricsRes.json(),
        servicesRes.json(),
        errorsRes.json(),
        backupsRes.json(),
      ]);

      setMetrics(metricsData);
      setServices(servicesData);
      setErrors(errorsData);
      setBackups(backupsData);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to load system data');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'healthy': return 'text-green-600 bg-green-100';
      case 'degraded': return 'text-yellow-600 bg-yellow-100';
      case 'down': return 'text-red-600 bg-red-100';
      default: return 'text-gray-600 bg-gray-100';
    }
  };

  const getLevelBadgeVariant = (level: string): 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'default' => {
    switch (level) {
      case 'CRITICAL': return 'danger';
      case 'ERROR': return 'danger';
      case 'WARN': return 'warning';
      default: return 'default';
    }
  };

  const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return Math.round((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
    if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ${seconds % 60}s`;
    return `${Math.floor(seconds / 3600)}h ${Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)}m`;
  };

  const formatUptime = (hours: number) => {
    const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
    const remainingHours = hours % 24;
    if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${remainingHours}h`;
    return `${remainingHours}h`;
  };

  const formatTimestamp = (timestamp: string) => {
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    return date.toLocaleString('en-US', {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
  };

  const getHealthPercentage = (value: number, max: number) => {
    return Math.min((value / max) * 100, 100);
  };

  const handleRunBackup = async () => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to start a manual backup? This may take several minutes.')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
      const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/system/backup', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to start backup');

      alert('Backup started successfully');
      fetchSystemData();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to start backup');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handleRestartService = async (serviceName: string) => {
    if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to restart the ${serviceName} service?`)) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
      const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:3001/api/admin/system/services/${serviceName}/restart`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to restart service');

      alert('Service restart initiated');
      fetchSystemData();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to restart service');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  if (loading && !metrics) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <LoadingSpinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const overallHealth = services.every(s => s.status === 'healthy') ? 'healthy' :
    services.some(s => s.status === 'down') ? 'critical' : 'warning';

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 pb-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">System Monitoring</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-600 mt-1">Real-time system health and performance</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <label className="flex items-center text-sm text-gray-700">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={autoRefresh}
                onChange={(e) => setAutoRefresh(e.target.checked)}
                className="mr-2"
              />
              Auto-refresh
            </label>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={fetchSystemData}>
              🔄 Refresh
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Overall Health Alert */}
        <Alert
          variant={overallHealth === 'healthy' ? 'success' : overallHealth === 'critical' ? 'danger' : 'warning'}
          className="mb-6"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <strong>System Status: {overallHealth.toUpperCase()}</strong>
              <p className="text-sm mt-1">
                {overallHealth === 'healthy' && 'All systems operational'}
                {overallHealth === 'warning' && 'Some services degraded - monitoring in progress'}
                {overallHealth === 'critical' && 'Critical issues detected - immediate attention required'}
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className={`text-4xl ${overallHealth === 'healthy' ? '' : 'animate-pulse'}`}>
              {overallHealth === 'healthy' ? '✓' : '⚠️'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </Alert>

        {error && <Alert variant="danger" className="mb-4">{error}</Alert>}

        {/* System Metrics */}
        {metrics && (
          <>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4">Performance Metrics</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 mb-8">
              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Uptime</div>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">{metrics.uptime}%</div>
              </Card>

              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">API Response</div>
                <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${metrics.apiResponseTime > 500 ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-green-600'}`}>
                  {metrics.apiResponseTime}ms
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">DB Response</div>
                <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${metrics.databaseResponseTime > 100 ? 'text-yellow-600' : 'text-green-600'}`}>
                  {metrics.databaseResponseTime}ms
                </div>
              </Card>

              <Card className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Active Conns</div>

              <Card className="text-center">

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, Button, Input, Badge, LoadingSpinner, Alert } from '@/components/ui';

interface User {
  id: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  role: string;
  status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'SUSPENDED';
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  lastLogin?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  mfaEnabled: boolean;
}

export default function UsersPage() {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<User[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterRole, setFilterRole] = useState<string>('all');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>('all');
  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedUser, setSelectedUser] = useState<User | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUsers();
  }, []);

  const fetchUsers = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
      const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/users', {
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch users');
      const data = await response.json();
      setUsers(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to load users');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getFilteredUsers = () => {
    let filtered = users;

    if (searchQuery) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(user =>
        user.firstName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        user.lastName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        user.email.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        user.phone.includes(query)
      );
    }

    if (filterRole !== 'all') {
      filtered = filtered.filter(user => user.role === filterRole);
    }

    if (filterStatus !== 'all') {
      filtered = filtered.filter(user => user.status === filterStatus);
    }

    return filtered;
  };

  const getStatusBadgeVariant = (status: string): 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'default' => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'ACTIVE': return 'success';
      case 'INACTIVE': return 'warning';
      case 'SUSPENDED': return 'danger';
      default: return 'default';
    }
  };

  const getRoleBadgeColor = (role: string) => {
    if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700';
    if (role === 'SCHOOL_OWNER' || role === 'PRINCIPAL') return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700';
    if (role === 'TEACHER') return 'bg-green-100 text-green-700';
    if (role === 'PARENT') return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700';
    return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700';
  };

  const handleSuspendUser = async (userId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to suspend this user?')) return;

    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
      const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:3001/api/admin/users/${userId}/suspend`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to suspend user');
      
      alert('User suspended successfully');
      fetchUsers();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to suspend user');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handleActivateUser = async (userId: string) => {
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
      const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:3001/api/admin/users/${userId}/activate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to activate user');
      
      alert('User activated successfully');
      fetchUsers();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to activate user');
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString: string) => {
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    });
  };

  const formatLastLogin = (dateString?: string) => {
    if (!dateString) return 'Never';
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffHours = Math.floor((now.getTime() - date.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
    
    if (diffHours < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h ago`;
    if (diffHours < 168) return `${Math.floor(diffHours / 24)}d ago`;
    return formatDate(dateString);
  };

  const filteredUsers = getFilteredUsers();
  const roleCount = (role: string) => users.filter(u => u.role === role).length;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <LoadingSpinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 pb-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">User Management</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-600 mt-1">Manage platform users and permissions</p>
          </div>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}>
            <span className="mr-2">+</span>
            Add User
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Stats Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-6 gap-4 mb-6">
          <Card className="text-center">
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Total Users</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{users.length}</div>
          </Card>
          <Card className="text-center">
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Active</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
              {users.filter(u => u.status === 'ACTIVE').length}
            </div>
          </Card>
          <Card className="text-center">
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Super Admins</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-600">
              {roleCount('SUPER_ADMIN')}
            </div>
          </Card>
          <Card className="text-center">
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">School Admins</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
              {roleCount('SCHOOL_OWNER') + roleCount('PRINCIPAL')}
            </div>
          </Card>
          <Card className="text-center">
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Teachers</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
              {roleCount('TEACHER')}
            </div>
          </Card>
          <Card className="text-center">
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Parents</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600">
              {roleCount('PARENT')}
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Filters */}
        <Card className="mb-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <Input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search by name, email, or phone..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <select
                value={filterRole}
                onChange={(e) => setFilterRole(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"
              >
                <option value="all">All Roles</option>
                <option value="SUPER_ADMIN">Super Admin</option>
                <option value="SCHOOL_OWNER">School Owner</option>
                <option value="PRINCIPAL">Principal</option>
                <option value="TEACHER">Teacher</option>
                <option value="PARENT">Parent</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <select
                value={filterStatus}
                onChange={(e) => setFilterStatus(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"
              >
                <option value="all">All Status</option>
                <option value="ACTIVE">Active</option>
                <option value="INACTIVE">Inactive</option>
                <option value="SUSPENDED">Suspended</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        {error && <Alert variant="danger" className="mb-4">{error}</Alert>}

        {/* Users List - Desktop */}
        <div className="hidden md:block">
          <Card className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full">
              <thead className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                    User
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                    Role
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                    School
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                    Status
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                    Last Login
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                    Security
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                    Actions
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                {filteredUsers.map((user) => (
                  <tr key={user.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                    <td className="px-4 py-4">
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                          {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">{user.email}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{user.phone}</div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-4">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold ${getRoleBadgeColor(user.role)}`}>
                        {user.role.replace('_', ' ')}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-4 text-sm text-gray-900">
                      {user.schoolName || '-'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-4">
                      <Badge variant={getStatusBadgeVariant(user.status)}>
                        {user.status}
                      </Badge>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600">
                      {formatLastLogin(user.lastLogin)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-4">
                      {user.mfaEnabled ? (
                        <Badge variant="success">MFA ✓</Badge>
                      ) : (
                        <Badge variant="warning">No MFA</Badge>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-4">
                      <div className="flex space-x-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setSelectedUser(user)}
                          className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-900 text-sm"
                        >
                          View
                        </button>
                        {user.status === 'SUSPENDED' ? (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleActivateUser(user.id)}
                            className="text-green-600 hover:text-green-900 text-sm"
                          >
                            Activate
                          </button>
                        ) : user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleSuspendUser(user.id)}
                            className="text-red-600 hover:text-red-900 text-sm"
                          >
                            Suspend
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Users List - Mobile */}
        <div className="md:hidden space-y-4">
          {filteredUsers.map((user) => (
            <Card key={user.id} className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                    {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{user.email}</p>
                  <span className={`inline-block mt-1 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold ${getRoleBadgeColor(user.role)}`}>
                    {user.role.replace('_', ' ')}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <Badge variant={getStatusBadgeVariant(user.status)}>
                  {user.status}
                </Badge>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 mb-3 text-sm">
                {user.schoolName && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-gray-600">School:</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{user.schoolName}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Last Login:</span>
                  <span>{formatLastLogin(user.lastLogin)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">MFA:</span>
                  <span>{user.mfaEnabled ? '✓ Enabled' : '✗ Disabled'}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex space-x-2">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  className="flex-1"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedUser(user)}
                >
                  View Details
                </Button>
                {user.status === 'SUSPENDED' ? (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="primary"
                    className="flex-1"
                    onClick={() => handleActivateUser(user.id)}
                  >
                    Activate
                  </Button>
                ) : user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    className="flex-1 text-red-600"
                    onClick={() => handleSuspendUser(user.id)}
                  >
                    Suspend
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* User Details Modal */}
        {selectedUser && (
          <UserDetailsModal
            user={selectedUser}
            onClose={() => setSelectedUser(null)}
            onUpdate={fetchUsers}
          />
        )}

        {/* Create User Modal */}
        {showCreateModal && (
          <CreateUserModal
            onClose={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}
            onSuccess={fetchUsers}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function UserDetailsModal({ user, onClose, onUpdate }: { user: User; onClose: () => void; onUpdate: () => void }) {

                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Last Name</div>

                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Role</div>

              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">Status</div>
                <Badge variant={user.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'success' : 'danger'}>
                  {user.status}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </div>

            {user.schoolName && (
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">School</div>
                <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{user.schoolName}</div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-600">MFA Status</div>
                <Badge variant={user.mfaEnabled ? 'success' : 'warning'}>
                  {user.mfaEnabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled'}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div>

                <div className="text-sm text-gray-900">
                  {user.lastLogin ? new Date(user.lastLogin).toLocaleString() : 'Never'}

// Create User Modal
function CreateUserModal({ onClose, onSuccess }: { onClose: () => void; onSuccess: () => void }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    role: 'TEACHER',
    schoolId: '',
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('adminToken');
      const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/admin/users', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(formData),
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to create user');

      alert('User created successfully! Temporary password sent to email.');
      onSuccess();
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Failed to create user');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 z-50" onClick={onClose}></div>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
        <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Add New User</h2>
          
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">First Name *</label>
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={formData.firstName}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, firstName: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Last Name *</label>
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={formData.lastName}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, lastName: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Email *</label>
              <Input
                type="email"
                required
                value={formData.email}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, email: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Phone *</label>
              <Input
                type="tel"
                required
                placeholder="254XXXXXXXXX"
                value={formData.phone}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, phone: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Role *</label>
              <select
                value={formData.role}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, role: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"
              >
                <option value="SUPER_ADMIN">Super Admin</option>
                <option value="SCHOOL_OWNER">School Owner</option>
                <option value="PRINCIPAL">Principal</option>
                <option value="TEACHER">Teacher</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="flex space-x-3 pt-4">
              <Button type="submit" variant="primary" className="flex-1" disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? 'Creating...' : 'Create User'}
              </Button>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="flex-1" onClick={onClose}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

File: apps/web/src/app/dashboard/attendance/page.tsx

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client';
import {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardContent,
  Badge,
  LoadingSpinner,
  Alert,
} from '@/components/ui';
import { StudentSelector } from '@/components/StudentSelector';
import { format, startOfMonth, endOfMonth, eachDayOfInterval, isSameDay, subMonths } from 'date-fns';

interface Student {
  id: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  admissionNumber: string;
  class: { name: string };
  stream: { name: string };
}

interface AttendanceRecord {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  status: 'PRESENT' | 'ABSENT' | 'LATE' | 'EXCUSED';
  remarks?: string;
}

interface AttendanceSummary {
  totalDays: number;
  presentCount: number;
  absentCount: number;
  lateCount: number;
  excusedCount: number;
  attendanceRate: number;
}

export default function AttendancePage() {
  const [selectedStudent, setSelectedStudent] = useState<Student | null>(null);
  const [attendance, setAttendance] = useState<AttendanceRecord[]>([]);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<AttendanceSummary | null>(null);
  const [currentMonth, setCurrentMonth] = useState(new Date());
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedStudent) {
      loadAttendanceData();
    }
  }, [selectedStudent, currentMonth]);

  const loadAttendanceData = async () => {
    if (!selectedStudent) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      const startDate = format(startOfMonth(currentMonth), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
      const endDate = format(endOfMonth(currentMonth), 'yyyy-MM-dd');

      const [attendanceData, summaryData] = await Promise.all([
        api.getStudentAttendance(selectedStudent.id, startDate, endDate),
        api.getStudentAttendanceReport(selectedStudent.id, startDate, endDate),
      ]);

      setAttendance(attendanceData);
      setSummary(summaryData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load attendance:', err);
      setError('Failed to load attendance information');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getAttendanceForDate = (date: Date): AttendanceRecord | undefined => {
    return attendance.find((record) =>
      isSameDay(new Date(record.date), date)
    );
  };

  const handlePreviousMonth = () => {
    setCurrentMonth(subMonths(currentMonth, 1));
  };

  const handleNextMonth = () => {
    const nextMonth = subMonths(currentMonth, -1);
    // Don't go beyond current month
    if (nextMonth <= new Date()) {
      setCurrentMonth(nextMonth);
    }
  };

  if (!selectedStudent) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        <StudentSelector onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6">
      <StudentSelector
        selectedStudent={selectedStudent}
        onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent}
      />

      {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
          <LoadingSpinner size="lg" message="Loading attendance..." />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Summary Cards */}
          {summary && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
              <Card padding="lg">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2">Attendance Rate</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-600">
                  {summary.attendanceRate.toFixed(1)}%
                </p>
              </Card>
              <Card padding="lg">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2">Present</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-success-600">
                  {summary.presentCount}
                </p>
              </Card>
              <Card padding="lg">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2">Absent</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-danger-600">
                  {summary.absentCount}
                </p>
              </Card>
              <Card padding="lg">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2">Late</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-warning-600">
                  {summary.lateCount}
                </p>
              </Card>
              <Card padding="lg">
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2">Excused</p>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-600">
                  {summary.excusedCount}
                </p>
              </Card>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Calendar View */}
          <Card>
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                  {format(currentMonth, 'MMMM yyyy')}
                </h2>
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={handlePreviousMonth}
                    className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors tap-area"
                  >
                    <svg
                      className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    >
                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleNextMonth}
                    disabled={subMonths(currentMonth, -1) > new Date()}
                    className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors tap-area disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                  >
                    <svg
                      className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    >
                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <CardContent>
              <AttendanceCalendar
                month={currentMonth}
                getAttendanceForDate={getAttendanceForDate}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* Attendance Legend */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader title="Legend" />
            <CardContent>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  <div className="w-4 h-4 bg-success-500 rounded"></div>
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-700">Present</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  <div className="w-4 h-4 bg-danger-500 rounded"></div>
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-700">Absent</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  <div className="w-4 h-4 bg-warning-500 rounded"></div>
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-700">Late</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  <div className="w-4 h-4 bg-gray-400 rounded"></div>
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-700">Excused</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* Detailed Records */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader
              title="Detailed Records"
              subtitle={`Attendance records for ${format(currentMonth, 'MMMM yyyy')}`}
            />
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {attendance.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {attendance
                    .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date).getTime() - new Date(a.date).getTime())
                    .map((record) => (
                      <div
                        key={record.id}
                        className="p-4 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                              {format(new Date(record.date), 'EEEE, MMMM dd, yyyy')}
                            </p>
                            {record.remarks && (
                              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                                {record.remarks}
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <AttendanceStatusBadge status={record.status} />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">
                  No attendance records for this month
                </p>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function AttendanceCalendar({
  month,
  getAttendanceForDate,
}: {
  month: Date;
  getAttendanceForDate: (date: Date) => AttendanceRecord | undefined;
}) {
  const monthStart = startOfMonth(month);
  const monthEnd = endOfMonth(month);
  const daysInMonth = eachDayOfInterval({ start: monthStart, end: monthEnd });

  // Get the day of week for the first day (0 = Sunday)
  const firstDayOfWeek = monthStart.getDay();

  const weekDays = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Week day headers */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-2 mb-2">
        {weekDays.map((day) => (
          <div
            key={day}
            className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 py-2"
          >
            {day}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Calendar grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-2">
        {/* Empty cells for days before month starts */}
        {Array.from({ length: firstDayOfWeek }).map((_, index) => (
          <div key={`empty-${index}`} className="aspect-square"></div>
        ))}

        {/* Days of the month */}
        {daysInMonth.map((date) => {
          const record = getAttendanceForDate(date);
          const isToday = isSameDay(date, new Date());
          const isFuture = date > new Date();

          return (
            <div
              key={date.toString()}
              className={`aspect-square flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border ${
                isToday
                  ? 'border-primary-500 border-2'
                  : 'border-gray-200'
              } ${isFuture ? 'bg-gray-50' : 'bg-white'}`}
            >
              <span
                className={`text-sm ${
                  isToday
                    ? 'font-bold text-primary-600'
                    : 'text-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                {format(date, 'd')}
              </span>
              {record && !isFuture && (
                <div
                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full mt-1 ${getStatusColor(
                    record.status
                  )}`}
                  title={record.status}
                ></div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AttendanceStatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const variants: Record<string, 'success' | 'danger' | 'warning' | 'default'> = {
    PRESENT: 'success',
    ABSENT: 'danger',
    LATE: 'warning',
    EXCUSED: 'default',
  };

  return <Badge variant={variants[status] || 'default'}>{status}</Badge>;
}

function getStatusColor(status: string): string {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    PRESENT: 'bg-success-500',
    ABSENT: 'bg-danger-500',
    LATE: 'bg-warning-500',
    EXCUSED: 'bg-gray-400',
  };

  return colors[status] || 'bg-gray-300';
}

export default function FeesPage() {
  const [selectedStudent, setSelectedStudent] = useState<Student | null>(null);
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [payments, setPayments] = useState<Payment[]>([]);
  const [selectedInvoice, setSelectedInvoice] = useState<Invoice | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [showPaymentModal, setShowPaymentModal] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedStudent) {
      loadFeeData();
    }
  }, [selectedStudent]);

  const loadFeeData = async () => {
    if (!selectedStudent) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      const [invoicesData, paymentsData] = await Promise.all([
        api.getStudentInvoices(selectedStudent.id),
        api.getStudentPayments(selectedStudent.id),
      ]);

      setInvoices(invoicesData);
      setPayments(paymentsData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load fee data:', err);
      setError('Failed to load fee information');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePayInvoice = (invoice: Invoice) => {
    setSelectedInvoice(invoice);
    setShowPaymentModal(true);
  };

  // Calculate totals
  const totalFees = invoices.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + inv.amount, 0);
  const totalPaid = invoices.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + inv.paidAmount, 0);
  const totalBalance = totalFees - totalPaid;

  if (!selectedStudent) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        <StudentSelector onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6">
      <StudentSelector
        selectedStudent={selectedStudent}
        onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent}
      />

      {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
          <LoadingSpinner size="lg" message="Loading fee information..." />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Summary Cards */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <Card padding="lg">
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">Total Fees</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
                KES {(totalFees / 100).toLocaleString()}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card padding="lg">
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">Amount Paid</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-success-600">
                KES {(totalPaid / 100).toLocaleString()}
              </p>
            </Card>
            <Card padding="lg">
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">Balance Outstanding</p>
              <p
                className={`text-3xl font-bold ${
                  totalBalance > 0 ? 'text-danger-600' : 'text-success-600'
                }`}
              >
                KES {(totalBalance / 100).toLocaleString()}
              </p>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* Outstanding Invoices */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader
              title="Outstanding Invoices"
              subtitle="Invoices awaiting payment"
            />
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {invoices.filter((inv) => inv.balance > 0).length > 0 ? (
                <div className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {invoices
                    .filter((inv) => inv.balance > 0)
                    .map((invoice) => (
                      <InvoiceRow
                        key={invoice.id}
                        invoice={invoice}
                        onPay={handlePayInvoice}
                      />
                    ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-8 text-center">
                  <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-success-50 rounded-full mb-4">
                    <svg
                      className="w-8 h-8 text-success-600"
                      fill="currentColor"
                      viewBox="0 0 20 20"
                    >
                      <path
                        fillRule="evenodd"
                        d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z"
                        clipRule="evenodd"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-gray-900 font-medium">All fees paid!</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                    You have no outstanding invoices
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* Payment History */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader
              title="Payment History"
              subtitle="All your past payments"
            />
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {payments.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {payments.map((payment) => (
                    <div
                      key={payment.id}
                      className="p-4 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 mb-1">
                            <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                              KES {(payment.amount / 100).toLocaleString()}
                            </p>
                            <Badge variant="success">{payment.paymentMethod}</Badge>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                            {format(new Date(payment.paymentDate), 'MMM dd, yyyy')} •
                            Receipt: {payment.receiptNumber}
                          </p>
                          {payment.transactionReference && (
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
                              Ref: {payment.transactionReference}
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">
                  No payment history available
                </p>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* All Invoices */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader title="All Invoices" />

              <div className="overflow-x-auto">

function InvoiceRow({
  invoice,
  onPay,
}: {
  invoice: Invoice;
  onPay: (invoice: Invoice) => void;
}) {
  const [showDetails, setShowDetails] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <div className="flex-1">
          <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">{invoice.invoiceNumber}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            Due: {format(new Date(invoice.dueDate), 'MMM dd, yyyy')}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
          <div className="text-right">
            <p className="text-lg font-bold text-danger-600">
              KES {(invoice.balance / 100).toLocaleString()}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
              of KES {(invoice.amount / 100).toLocaleString()}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onPay(invoice)}>
            Pay Now
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        onClick={() => setShowDetails(!showDetails)}
        className="text-sm text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-700 flex items-center space-x-1"
      >
        <span>{showDetails ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} details</span>
        <svg
          className={`w-4 h-4 transition-transform ${
            showDetails ? 'rotate-180' : ''
          }`}
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"

        >
          <path
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeWidth={2}
            d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"
          />
        </svg>
      </button>

      {showDetails && (
        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-200">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Invoice Items:</p>
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {invoice.items.map((item, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-gray-600">{item.description}</span>
                <span className="text-gray-900 font-medium">
                  KES {(item.amount / 100).toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

interface PaymentModalProps {
  invoice: Invoice;
  student: Student;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

function PaymentModal({ invoice, student, onClose, onSuccess }: PaymentModalProps) {
  const [phoneNumber, setPhoneNumber] = useState('');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(invoice.balance);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');
    setIsProcessing(true);

    try {
      // Format phone number (remove spaces, ensure starts with 254)
      let formattedPhone = phoneNumber.replace(/\s/g, '');
      if (formattedPhone.startsWith('0')) {
        formattedPhone = '254' + formattedPhone.substring(1);
      } else if (!formattedPhone.startsWith('254')) {
        formattedPhone = '254' + formattedPhone;
      }

      await api.initiateSTKPush({
        invoiceId: invoice.id,
        phoneNumber: formattedPhone,
        amount,
      });

      setSuccess(
        'Payment request sent! Please check your phone and enter your M-Pesa PIN to complete the payment.'
      );

      // Close modal after 3 seconds and refresh data
      setTimeout(() => {
        onSuccess();
      }, 3000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Payment error:', err);
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.message ||
          'Failed to initiate payment. Please try again.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Overlay */}
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50"
        onClick={onClose}
      ></div>

      {/* Modal */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <Card className="w-full max-w-lg animate-fade-in">
          <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-200">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">
                Pay with M-Pesa
              </h2>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 tap-area"
              >
                <svg
                  className="w-6 h-6"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                >
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
                  />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-6">
            {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}
            {success && <Alert variant="success">{success}</Alert>}

            {/* Invoice Details */}
            <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-gray-600">Student:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                  {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-gray-600">Invoice:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                  {invoice.invoiceNumber}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-gray-600">Balance Due:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-danger-600">
                  KES {(invoice.balance / 100).toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Payment Form */}
            <Input
              label="M-Pesa Phone Number"
              type="tel"
              value={phoneNumber}
              onChange={(e) => setPhoneNumber(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="0712345678"
              required
              helpText="Enter the phone number registered with M-Pesa"
              disabled={isProcessing || !!success}
            />

            <Input
              label="Amount to Pay (KES)"
              type="number"
              value={amount / 100}
              onChange={(e) => setAmount(parseFloat(e.target.value) * 100)}
              min={1}
              max={invoice.balance / 100}
              required
              helpText={`Maximum: KES ${(invoice.balance / 100).toLocaleString()}`}
              disabled={isProcessing || !!success}
            />

            <div className="flex space-x-3">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                fullWidth
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isProcessing}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                fullWidth
                isLoading={isProcessing}
                disabled={!!success}
              >
                {success ? 'Payment Initiated' : 'Send Payment Request'}
              </Button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 text-center">
              You will receive an M-Pesa prompt on your phone. Enter your PIN to
              complete the payment.
            </p>
          </form>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client';
import {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardContent,
  Badge,
  Button,
  LoadingSpinner,
  Alert,
} from '@/components/ui';
import { StudentSelector } from '@/components/StudentSelector';
import { format } from 'date-fns';

interface Student {
  id: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  admissionNumber: string;
  class: { name: string };
  stream: { name: string };
}

interface Grade {
  id: string;
  marks: number;
  grade: string;
  remarks?: string;
  subject: {
    name: string;
    code: string;
  };
  exam: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    term: {
      name: string;
      year: number;
    };
  };
}

interface ReportCard {
  id: string;
  status: string;
  overallGrade: string;
  overallPercentage: number;
  position?: number;
  totalStudents?: number;
  teacherComment?: string;
  principalComment?: string;
  exam: {
    name: string;
    term: {
      name: string;
      year: number;
    };
  };
  grades: Array<{
    subject: { name: string };
    marks: number;
    grade: string;
  }>;
  createdAt: string;
}

export default function GradesPage() {
  const [selectedStudent, setSelectedStudent] = useState<Student | null>(null);
  const [grades, setGrades] = useState<Grade[]>([]);
  const [reportCards, setReportCards] = useState<ReportCard[]>([]);
  const [selectedReportCard, setSelectedReportCard] = useState<ReportCard | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedStudent) {
      loadGradesData();
    }
  }, [selectedStudent]);

  const loadGradesData = async () => {
    if (!selectedStudent) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      const [gradesData, reportCardsData] = await Promise.all([
        api.getStudentGrades(selectedStudent.id),
        api.getStudentReportCards(selectedStudent.id),
      ]);

      setGrades(gradesData);
      setReportCards(reportCardsData.filter((rc: ReportCard) => rc.status === 'PUBLISHED'));
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load grades:', err);
      setError('Failed to load grades information');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Group grades by term
  const gradesByTerm = grades.reduce((acc: Record<string, Grade[]>, grade) => {
    const termKey = `${grade.exam.term.name} ${grade.exam.term.year}`;
    if (!acc[termKey]) {
      acc[termKey] = [];
    }
    acc[termKey].push(grade);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  if (!selectedStudent) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        <StudentSelector onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6">
      <StudentSelector
        selectedStudent={selectedStudent}
        onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent}
      />

      {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
          <LoadingSpinner size="lg" message="Loading grades..." />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Report Cards Section */}
          {reportCards.length > 0 && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader
                title="Report Cards"
                subtitle="Download your published report cards"
              />
              <CardContent>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  {reportCards.map((reportCard) => (
                    <ReportCardItem
                      key={reportCard.id}
                      reportCard={reportCard}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedReportCard(reportCard)}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Recent Grades Summary */}
          {grades.length > 0 && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader title="Recent Performance" />
              <CardContent>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                  <StatCard
                    label="Average Grade"
                    value={calculateAverageGrade(grades)}
                    color="primary"
                  />
                  <StatCard
                    label="Highest Score"
                    value={`${Math.max(...grades.map((g) => g.marks))}%`}
                    color="success"
                  />
                  <StatCard
                    label="Lowest Score"
                    value={`${Math.min(...grades.map((g) => g.marks))}%`}
                    color="warning"
                  />
                  <StatCard
                    label="Subjects"
                    value={new Set(grades.map((g) => g.subject.name)).size.toString()}
                    color="info"
                  />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Grades by Term */}
          {Object.keys(gradesByTerm).length > 0 ? (
            Object.entries(gradesByTerm).map(([term, termGrades]) => (
              <Card key={term}>
                <CardHeader
                  title={term}
                  subtitle={`${termGrades.length} subjects`}
                />
                <CardContent className="p-0">
                  <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full">
                      <thead className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
                        <tr>
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                            Subject
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                            Exam
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                            Marks
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                            Grade
                          </th>
                          <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                            Remarks
                          </th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                        {termGrades.map((grade) => (
                          <tr key={grade.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
                              {grade.subject.name}
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-500">
                              {grade.exam.name}
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-center">
                              <span
                                className={`font-semibold ${
                                  grade.marks >= 75
                                    ? 'text-success-600'
                                    : grade.marks >= 50
                                    ? 'text-primary-600'
                                    : 'text-danger-600'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {grade.marks}%
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                              <GradeBadge grade={grade.grade} />
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-500">
                              {grade.remarks || '-'}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            ))
          ) : (
            <Card>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="text-center py-12">
                  <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-gray-100 rounded-full mb-4">
                    <svg
                      className="w-8 h-8 text-gray-400"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    >
                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-gray-900 font-medium mb-1">No grades available yet</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                    Grades will appear here once exams are graded and published
                  </p>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {/* Report Card Detail Modal */}
      {selectedReportCard && (
        <ReportCardModal
          reportCard={selectedReportCard}
          student={selectedStudent}
          onClose={() => setSelectedReportCard(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  color,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  color: 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'info';
}) {
  const colors = {
    primary: 'bg-primary-50 text-primary-700',
    success: 'bg-success-50 text-success-700',
    warning: 'bg-warning-50 text-warning-700',
    info: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700',
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-lg p-4 ${colors[color]}`}>
      <p className="text-xs font-medium mb-1 opacity-75">{label}</p>
      <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function GradeBadge({ grade }: { grade: string }) {
  const variants: Record<string, 'success' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger'> = {
    A: 'success',
    B: 'info',
    C: 'warning',
    D: 'danger',
    E: 'danger',
  };

  return (
    <Badge variant={variants[grade] || 'default'} size="sm">
      {grade}
    </Badge>
  );
}

function calculateAverageGrade(grades: Grade[]): string {
  if (grades.length === 0) return '-';
  const average = grades.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.marks, 0) / grades.length;
  
  if (average >= 80) return 'A';
  if (average >= 70) return 'B';
  if (average >= 60) return 'C';
  if (average >= 50) return 'D';
  return 'E';
}

interface Notification {

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

    setNotifications((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, isRead: true })));
  };

  const filteredNotifications =

  const unreadCount = notifications.filter((n) => !n.isRead).length;

                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        d="M15 17h5l-1.405-1.405A2.032 2.032 0 0118 14.158V11a6.002 6.002 0 00-4-5.659V5a2 2 0 10-4 0v.341C7.67 6.165 6 8.388 6 11v3.159c0 .538-.214 1.055-.595 1.436L4 17h5m6 0v1a3 3 0 11-6 0v-1m6 0H9"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-gray-900 font-medium mb-1">No notifications</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                    {filter === 'unread'
                      ? 'You have no unread notifications'
                      : 'You have no notifications yet'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function NotificationCard({
  notification,
  onMarkAsRead,
}: {
  notification: Notification;
  onMarkAsRead: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  const getIcon = (type: Notification['type']) => {
    const icons = {
      FEE_REMINDER: (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
          <path d="M4 4a2 2 0 00-2 2v1h16V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H4z" />
          <path
            fillRule="evenodd"
            d="M18 9H2v5a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V9zM4 13a1 1 0 011-1h1a1 1 0 110 2H5a1 1 0 01-1-1zm5-1a1 1 0 100 2h1a1 1 0 100-2H9z"
            clipRule="evenodd"
          />
        </svg>
      ),
      ABSENCE_ALERT: (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
          <path
            fillRule="evenodd"
            d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7 4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-9a1 1 0 00-1 1v4a1 1 0 102 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z"
            clipRule="evenodd"
          />
        </svg>
      ),
      EXAM_SCHEDULE: (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
          <path d="M9 4.804A7.968 7.968 0 005.5 4c-1.255 0-2.443.29-3.5.804v10A7.969 7.969 0 015.5 14c1.669 0 3.218.51 4.5 1.385A7.962 7.962 0 0114.5 14c1.255 0 2.443.29 3.5.804v-10A7.968 7.968 0 0014.5 4c-1.255 0-2.443.29-3.5.804V12a1 1 0 11-2 0V4.804z" />
        </svg>
      ),
      PAYMENT_RECEIPT: (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
          <path
            fillRule="evenodd"
            d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z"
            clipRule="evenodd"
          />
        </svg>
      ),
      GENERAL: (
        <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
          <path
            fillRule="evenodd"
            d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z"
            clipRule="evenodd"
          />
        </svg>
      ),
    };

    return icons[type] || icons.GENERAL;
  };

  const getColor = (type: Notification['type']) => {
    const colors = {
      FEE_REMINDER: 'bg-warning-100 text-warning-700',
      ABSENCE_ALERT: 'bg-danger-100 text-danger-700',
      EXAM_SCHEDULE: 'bg-primary-100 text-primary-700',
      PAYMENT_RECEIPT: 'bg-success-100 text-success-700',
      GENERAL: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700',
    };

    return colors[type] || colors.GENERAL;
  };

  const getPriorityBadge = (priority: Notification['priority']) => {
    const variants: Record<string, 'danger' | 'warning' | 'default'> = {
      HIGH: 'danger',
      MEDIUM: 'warning',
      LOW: 'default',
    };

    return <Badge variant={variants[priority]} size="sm">{priority}</Badge>;
  };

  return (
    <Card
      className={`cursor-pointer transition-all ${
        !notification.isRead ? 'border-l-4 border-l-primary-500 bg-primary-50/30' : ''
      }`}
      onClick={() => {
        setExpanded(!expanded);
        if (!notification.isRead) {
          onMarkAsRead(notification.id);
        }
      }}
    >
      <div className="p-4">
        <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
          {/* Icon */}
          <div className={`flex-shrink-0 w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ${getColor(notification.type)}`}>
            {getIcon(notification.type)}
          </div>

          {/* Content */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-1">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">
                  {notification.title}
                </h3>
                {!notification.isRead && (
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 bg-primary-600 rounded-full"></span>
                )}
              </div>
              {getPriorityBadge(notification.priority)}
            </div>

            <p className={`text-sm text-gray-600 ${!expanded ? 'truncate' : ''}`}>
              {notification.message}
            </p>

            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">
              {formatDistanceToNow(new Date(notification.createdAt), {
                addSuffix: true,
              })} • {format(new Date(notification.createdAt), 'MMM dd, yyyy h:mm a')}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Expand icon */}
          <button className="flex-shrink-0 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 tap-area">
            <svg
              className={`w-5 h-5 transition-transform ${
                expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''
              }`}
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7"
              />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
