'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client';
import { Card, CardHeader, CardContent, Badge, LoadingSpinner, Alert } from '@/components/ui';
import { StudentSelector } from '@/components/StudentSelector';
import { format } from 'date-fns';

interface Student {
  id: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  admissionNumber: string;
  class: { name: string };
  stream: { name: string };
}

interface DashboardData {
  feeBalance: number;
  totalFees: number;
  paidFees: number;
  attendanceRate: number;
  presentDays: number;
  totalDays: number;
  recentGrades: Array<{
    id: string;
    subject: { name: string };
    marks: number;
    grade: string;
    examName: string;
  }>;
  upcomingEvents: Array<{
    id: string;
    title: string;
    date: string;
    type: string;
  }>;
  recentPayments: Array<{
    id: string;
    amount: number;
    paymentDate: string;
    receiptNumber: string;
  }>;
}

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const [selectedStudent, setSelectedStudent] = useState<Student | null>(null);
  const [dashboardData, setDashboardData] = useState<DashboardData | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedStudent) {
      loadDashboardData();
    }
  }, [selectedStudent]);

  const loadDashboardData = async () => {
    if (!selectedStudent) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      // Load all dashboard data in parallel
      const [invoices, attendance, grades, payments] = await Promise.all([
        api.getStudentInvoices(selectedStudent.id),
        api.getStudentAttendanceReport(selectedStudent.id),
        api.getStudentGrades(selectedStudent.id),
        api.getStudentPayments(selectedStudent.id),
      ]);

      // Calculate fee totals
      const totalFees = invoices.reduce((sum: number, inv: any) => sum + inv.amount, 0);
      const paidFees = invoices.reduce((sum: number, inv: any) => sum + inv.paidAmount, 0);
      const feeBalance = totalFees - paidFees;

      // Get recent payments (last 3)
      const recentPayments = payments.slice(0, 3);

      // Get recent grades (last 5)
      const recentGrades = grades.slice(0, 5);

      setDashboardData({
        feeBalance,
        totalFees,
        paidFees,
        attendanceRate: attendance.attendanceRate || 0,
        presentDays: attendance.presentCount || 0,
        totalDays: attendance.totalDays || 0,
        recentGrades,
        upcomingEvents: [], // TODO: Fetch from calendar API when available
        recentPayments,
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load dashboard data:', err);
      setError('Failed to load dashboard data. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!selectedStudent) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        <StudentSelector onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6">
      {/* Student Selector */}
      <StudentSelector
        selectedStudent={selectedStudent}
        onSelectStudent={setSelectedStudent}
      />

      {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
          <LoadingSpinner size="lg" message="Loading dashboard..." />
        </div>
      ) : dashboardData ? (
        <>
          {/* Welcome Section */}
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-primary-600 to-primary-700 rounded-2xl p-6 text-white">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">
              Welcome back!
            </h1>
            <p className="text-primary-100">
              Here's an overview of {selectedStudent.firstName}'s academic progress
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Key Metrics */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {/* Fee Balance */}
            <Card padding="lg" hover>
              <a href="/dashboard/fees" className="block">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Fee Balance</p>
                    <p className={`text-3xl font-bold ${
                      dashboardData.feeBalance > 0 ? 'text-danger-600' : 'text-success-600'
                    }`}>
                      KES {(dashboardData.feeBalance / 100).toLocaleString()}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">
                      Paid: KES {(dashboardData.paidFees / 100).toLocaleString()} of{' '}
                      {(dashboardData.totalFees / 100).toLocaleString()}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-warning-50 rounded-lg">
                    <svg
                      className="w-6 h-6 text-warning-600"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    >
                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        d="M3 10h18M7 15h1m4 0h1m-7 4h12a3 3 0 003-3V8a3 3 0 00-3-3H6a3 3 0 00-3 3v8a3 3 0 003 3z"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {dashboardData.feeBalance > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-4">
                    <span className="text-sm text-primary-600 font-medium hover:text-primary-700">
                      Pay now with M-Pesa →
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </a>
            </Card>

            {/* Attendance */}
            <Card padding="lg" hover>
              <a href="/dashboard/attendance" className="block">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Attendance Rate</p>
                    <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
                      {dashboardData.attendanceRate.toFixed(1)}%
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">
                      {dashboardData.presentDays} of {dashboardData.totalDays} days
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-success-50 rounded-lg">
                    <svg
                      className="w-6 h-6 text-success-600"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    >
                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-4">
                  <span className="text-sm text-primary-600 font-medium hover:text-primary-700">
                    View details →
                  </span>
                </div>
              </a>
            </Card>

            {/* Recent Grade */}
            <Card padding="lg" hover>
              <a href="/dashboard/grades" className="block">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Latest Grade</p>
                    {dashboardData.recentGrades.length > 0 ? (
                      <>
                        <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
                          {dashboardData.recentGrades[0].grade}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">
                          {dashboardData.recentGrades[0].subject.name}
                        </p>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">No grades yet</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-primary-50 rounded-lg">
                    <svg
                      className="w-6 h-6 text-primary-600"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    >
                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-4">
                  <span className="text-sm text-primary-600 font-medium hover:text-primary-700">
                    View all grades →
                  </span>
                </div>
              </a>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* Recent Activity Grid */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            {/* Recent Grades */}
            <Card>
              <CardHeader
                title="Recent Grades"
                action={
                  <a
                    href="/dashboard/grades"
                    className="text-sm text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-700 font-medium"
                  >
                    View all
                  </a>
                }
              />
              <CardContent>
                {dashboardData.recentGrades.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    {dashboardData.recentGrades.map((grade) => (
                      <div
                        key={grade.id}
                        className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0"
                      >
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
                            {grade.subject.name}
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{grade.examName}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                          <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">
                            {grade.marks}%
                          </span>
                          <Badge
                            variant={
                              grade.grade === 'A'
                                ? 'success'
                                : grade.grade === 'B'
                                ? 'info'
                                : grade.grade === 'C'
                                ? 'warning'
                                : 'danger'
                            }
                          >
                            Grade {grade.grade}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center py-8">
                    No grades available yet
                  </p>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* Recent Payments */}
            <Card>
              <CardHeader
                title="Recent Payments"
                action={
                  <a
                    href="/dashboard/fees"
                    className="text-sm text-primary-600 hover:text-primary-700 font-medium"
                  >

                        <div>

                            KES {(payment.amount / 100).toLocaleString()}

                            {format(new Date(payment.paymentDate), 'MMM dd, yyyy')}

function QuickAction({
  href,
  icon,
  label,
  color,
}: {
  href: string;
  icon: string;
  label: string;
  color: 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';
}) {
  const colors = {
    primary: 'bg-primary-50 text-primary-600 hover:bg-primary-100',
    success: 'bg-success-50 text-success-600 hover:bg-success-100',
    warning: 'bg-warning-50 text-warning-600 hover:bg-warning-100',
    danger: 'bg-danger-50 text-danger-600 hover:bg-danger-100',
  };

  const icons: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = {
    wallet: (
      <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeWidth={2}
          d="M3 10h18M7 15h1m4 0h1m-7 4h12a3 3 0 003-3V8a3 3 0 00-3-3H6a3 3 0 00-3 3v8a3 3 0 003 3z"
        />
      </svg>
    ),
    calendar: (
      <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeWidth={2}
          d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"
        />
      </svg>
    ),
    book: (
      <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeWidth={2}
          d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253"
        />
      </svg>
    ),
    bell: (
      <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeWidth={2}
          d="M15 17h5l-1.405-1.405A2.032 2.032 0 0118 14.158V11a6.002 6.002 0 00-4-5.659V5a2 2 0 10-4 0v.341C7.67 6.165 6 8.388 6 11v3.159c0 .538-.214 1.055-.595 1.436L4 17h5m6 0v1a3 3 0 11-6 0v-1m6 0H9"
        />
      </svg>
    ),
  };

  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 rounded-xl transition-colors tap-area ${colors[color]}`}
    >
      {icons[icon]}
      <span className="text-sm font-medium mt-2">{label}</span>
    </a>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { Inter } from 'next/font/google';
import './globals.css';

const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'] });

'use client';

import { useState, FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await api.login(email, password);
      
      // Store tokens
      localStorage.setItem('accessToken', response.accessToken);
      localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', response.refreshToken);
      
      // Store user info
      localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(response.user));

      // Redirect to dashboard
      router.push('/dashboard');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Login error:', err);
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.message || 
        'Invalid email or password. Please try again.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-primary-50 to-primary-100 px-4 py-12">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        {/* Logo and Title */}
        <div className="text-center mb-8">

            <svg

              viewBox="0 0 24 24"

              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253"

          </div>

            Krypton School ERP
          </h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600">Parent Portal Login</p>
        </div>

        {/* Login Form */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-8">
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            {error && (
              <div className="bg-danger-50 border border-danger-200 text-danger-700 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-sm">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <label
                htmlFor="email"
                className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2"
              >
                Email Address
              </label>
              <input
                id="email"

                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500 focus:border-transparent transition-colors"
                placeholder="parent@example.com"
                autoComplete="email"
                disabled={isLoading}
              />
            </div>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { format } from 'date-fns';

interface Student {
  id: string;
  admissionNumber: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  photo?: string;
}

interface AttendanceRecord {
  studentId: string;
  status: 'PRESENT' | 'ABSENT' | 'LATE' | 'EXCUSED';
  remarks?: string;
}

interface ClassInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  stream: string;
  students: Student[];
}

export default function TeacherAttendancePage() {
  const [selectedClass, setSelectedClass] = useState<string>('');
  const [classes, setClasses] = useState<ClassInfo[]>([]);
  const [students, setStudents] = useState<Student[]>([]);
  const [attendance, setAttendance] = useState<Record<string, AttendanceRecord>>({});
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(format(new Date(), 'yyyy-MM-dd'));
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<number>(1);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    loadClasses();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedClass) {
      loadStudents();
    }
  }, [selectedClass, selectedDate]);

  const loadClasses = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      // Mock data - replace with API call
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      
      const mockClasses = [
        {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Grade 5',
          stream: 'A',
          students: generateMockStudents(32, '5A'),
        },
        {
          id: '2',
          name: 'Grade 5',
          stream: 'B',
          students: generateMockStudents(30, '5B'),
        },
        {
          id: '3',
          name: 'Grade 6',
          stream: 'A',
          students: generateMockStudents(28, '6A'),
        },
      ];

      setClasses(mockClasses);
      if (mockClasses.length > 0) {
        setSelectedClass(mockClasses[0].id);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError('Failed to load classes');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadStudents = async () => {
    const classInfo = classes.find((c) => c.id === selectedClass);
    if (!classInfo) return;

    setStudents(classInfo.students);

    // Initialize attendance records
    const initialAttendance: Record<string, AttendanceRecord> = {};
    classInfo.students.forEach((student) => {
      initialAttendance[student.id] = {
        studentId: student.id,
        status: 'PRESENT',
      };
    });
    setAttendance(initialAttendance);
  };

  const handleStatusChange = (studentId: string, status: AttendanceRecord['status']) => {
    setAttendance((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [studentId]: {
        ...prev[studentId],
        status,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleRemarksChange = (studentId: string, remarks: string) => {
    setAttendance((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [studentId]: {
        ...prev[studentId],
        remarks,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleMarkAll = (status: AttendanceRecord['status']) => {
    const updated: Record<string, AttendanceRecord> = {};
    students.forEach((student) => {
      updated[student.id] = {
        studentId: student.id,
        status,
      };
    });
    setAttendance(updated);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');

    try {
      // Mock API call - replace with actual API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));

      const records = Object.values(attendance);
      console.log('Saving attendance:', {
        classId: selectedClass,
        date: selectedDate,
        period,
        records,
      });

      setSuccess(`Attendance saved successfully for ${students.length} students!`);

      // Auto-hide success message after 3 seconds
      setTimeout(() => setSuccess(''), 3000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError('Failed to save attendance. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // Calculate stats
  const stats = {
    present: Object.values(attendance).filter((a) => a.status === 'PRESENT').length,
    absent: Object.values(attendance).filter((a) => a.status === 'ABSENT').length,
    late: Object.values(attendance).filter((a) => a.status === 'LATE').length,
    excused: Object.values(attendance).filter((a) => a.status === 'EXCUSED').length,
  };

  const selectedClassInfo = classes.find((c) => c.id === selectedClass);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <LoadingSpinner size="lg" message="Loading classes..." />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Mark Attendance</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 mt-1">Record student attendance for today</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}
      {success && <Alert variant="success">{success}</Alert>}

      {/* Filters */}
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                Select Class
              </label>
              <select
                value={selectedClass}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedClass(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                {classes.map((cls) => (
                  <option key={cls.id} value={cls.id}>
                    {cls.name} {cls.stream} ({cls.students.length} students)
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                Date
              </label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={selectedDate}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedDate(e.target.value)}
                max={format(new Date(), 'yyyy-MM-dd')}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                Period
              </label>
              <select
                value={period}
                onChange={(e) => setPeriod(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map((p) => (
                  <option key={p} value={p}>
                    Period {p}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>

                      Admission No.
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                      Student Name
                    </th>

                      Status

function StatusButton({
  status,
  isSelected,
  onClick,
}: {
  status: string;
  isSelected: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
}) {
  const config: Record<
    string,
    { label: string; color: string; activeColor: string }
  > = {
    PRESENT: {
      label: 'P',
      color: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-green-600',
      activeColor: 'bg-green-600 text-white',
    },
    ABSENT: {
      label: 'A',
      color: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600',
      activeColor: 'bg-red-600 text-white',
    },
    LATE: {
      label: 'L',
      color: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-orange-600',
      activeColor: 'bg-orange-600 text-white',
    },
    EXCUSED: {
      label: 'E',
      color: 'text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600',
      activeColor: 'bg-gray-600 text-white',
    },
  };

  const { label, color, activeColor } = config[status];

  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-md font-semibold text-sm transition-colors ${
        isSelected ? activeColor : `border border-gray-300 ${color}`
      }`}
      title={status}
    >
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}

function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  color,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  color: string;
}) {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    green: 'bg-green-50 text-green-700 border-green-200',
    red: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200',
    orange: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200',
    gray: 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-gray-200',
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-lg border-2 p-4 ${colors[color]}`}>
      <p className="text-sm font-medium mb-1">{label}</p>
      <p className="text-3xl font-bold">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function generateMockStudents(count: number, classCode: string): Student[] {
  const firstNames = [
    'John',
    'Mary',
    'Peter',
    'Jane',
    'David',
    'Sarah',
    'Michael',
    'Emily',
    'James',
    'Grace',
  ];
  const lastNames = [
    'Smith',
    'Johnson',
    'Kamau',
    'Wanjiku',
    'Ochieng',
    'Akinyi',
    'Mutua',
    'Mwangi',
    'Omondi',
    'Njeri',
  ];

  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `${classCode}-${i + 1}`,
    admissionNumber: `ADM-2024-${classCode}-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
    firstName: firstNames[i % firstNames.length],
    lastName: lastNames[i % lastNames.length],
  }));
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Card, Button, Input, Badge, LoadingSpinner, Alert } from '@/components/ui';

interface Class {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  stream: string;
  level: string;
  studentCount: number;
  subjects: string[];
  classTeacher?: string;
  averageAttendance: number;
  averageGrade: number;
}

interface Student {
  id: string;
  admissionNumber: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  gender: 'MALE' | 'FEMALE';
  dateOfBirth: string;
  status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'GRADUATED' | 'WITHDRAWN';
  attendancePercentage: number;
  averageGrade: number;
  feesBalance: number;
  guardianPhone: string;
  guardianName: string;
  recentAbsences: number;
}

export default function ClassesPage() {
  const [classes, setClasses] = useState<Class[]>([]);
  const [selectedClass, setSelectedClass] = useState<Class | null>(null);
  const [students, setStudents] = useState<Student[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [studentsLoading, setStudentsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>('all');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'name' | 'attendance' | 'grade'>('name');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClasses();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedClass) {
      fetchStudents(selectedClass.id);
    }
  }, [selectedClass]);

  const fetchClasses = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
      const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3001/api/classes/teacher', {
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch classes');
      const data = await response.json();
      setClasses(data);
      
      // Auto-select first class if available
      if (data.length > 0 && !selectedClass) {
        setSelectedClass(data[0]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to load classes');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchStudents = async (classId: string) => {
    try {
      setStudentsLoading(true);
      const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
      const response = await fetch(`http://localhost:3001/api/classes/${classId}/students`, {
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch students');
      const data = await response.json();
      setStudents(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Failed to load students');
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setStudentsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getFilteredAndSortedStudents = () => {
    let filtered = students;

    // Filter by search query
    if (searchQuery) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.filter(student =>
        student.firstName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        student.lastName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        student.admissionNumber.toLowerCase().includes(query)
      );
    }

    // Filter by status
    if (filterStatus !== 'all') {
      filtered = filtered.filter(student => student.status === filterStatus);
    }

    // Sort
    const sorted = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortBy === 'name') {
        return `${a.firstName} ${a.lastName}`.localeCompare(`${b.firstName} ${b.lastName}`);
      } else if (sortBy === 'attendance') {
        return b.attendancePercentage - a.attendancePercentage;
      } else if (sortBy === 'grade') {
        return b.averageGrade - a.averageGrade;
      }
      return 0;
    });

    return sorted;
  };

  const getPerformanceColor = (value: number, type: 'attendance' | 'grade') => {
    if (type === 'attendance') {
      if (value >= 95) return 'text-green-600';
      if (value >= 85) return 'text-yellow-600';
      return 'text-red-600';
    } else {
      if (value >= 80) return 'text-green-600';
      if (value >= 60) return 'text-yellow-600';
      return 'text-red-600';
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadgeVariant = (status: string): 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'default' => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'ACTIVE': return 'success';
      case 'INACTIVE': return 'warning';
      case 'WITHDRAWN': return 'danger';
      default: return 'default';
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <LoadingSpinner size="lg" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error && classes.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4">
        <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const filteredStudents = getFilteredAndSortedStudents();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 pb-20 md:pb-4">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6">
        <div className="mb-6">
          <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">My Classes</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 mt-1">Manage your assigned classes and students</p>
        </div>

        {/* Classes Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-8">
          {classes.map((classItem) => (
            <Card
              key={classItem.id}
              className={`cursor-pointer transition-all hover:shadow-lg ${
                selectedClass?.id === classItem.id ? 'ring-2 ring-blue-500' : ''
              }`}
              onClick={() => setSelectedClass(classItem)}
            >
              <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg text-gray-900">
                    {classItem.name} {classItem.stream}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{classItem.level}</p>
                </div>
                <Badge variant="default">{classItem.studentCount} students</Badge>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 mb-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Avg. Attendance:</span>
                  <span className={`font-semibold ${getPerformanceColor(classItem.averageAttendance, 'attendance')}`}>
                    {classItem.averageAttendance}%
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-gray-600">Avg. Grade:</span>
                  <span className={`font-semibold ${getPerformanceColor(classItem.averageGrade, 'grade')}`}>
                    {classItem.averageGrade}%
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {classItem.subjects.length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {classItem.subjects.slice(0, 3).map((subject, idx) => (
                    <span
                      key={idx}
                      className="px-2 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 text-xs rounded"
                    >
                      {subject}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                  {classItem.subjects.length > 3 && (
                    <span className="px-2 py-1 bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 text-xs rounded">
                      +{classItem.subjects.length - 3} more
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Student List Section */}
        {selectedClass && (
          <Card className="mb-6">
            <div className="border-b border-gray-200 pb-4 mb-4">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">
                {selectedClass.name} {selectedClass.stream} Students
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">
                {filteredStudents.length} of {students.length} students
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Filters and Search */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search by name or admission number..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <select
                  value={filterStatus}
                  onChange={(e) => setFilterStatus(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Status</option>
                  <option value="ACTIVE">Active</option>
                  <option value="INACTIVE">Inactive</option>
                  <option value="GRADUATED">Graduated</option>
                  <option value="WITHDRAWN">Withdrawn</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <select
                  value={sortBy}
                  onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as 'name' | 'attendance' | 'grade')}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="name">Sort by Name</option>
                  <option value="attendance">Sort by Attendance</option>
                  <option value="grade">Sort by Grade</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Students Table */}
            {studentsLoading ? (
              <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
                <LoadingSpinner size="lg" />
              </div>
            ) : filteredStudents.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-12">
                <p className="text-gray-500">No students found</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* Desktop Table View */}
                <div className="hidden md:block overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full">
                    <thead className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Adm. No
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Student Name
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Gender
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Attendance
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Avg. Grade
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Status
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Guardian
                        </th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Actions
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                      {filteredStudents.map((student) => (
                        <tr key={student.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                          <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
                            {student.admissionNumber}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                            <div className="flex items-center">
                              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-blue-100 flex items-center justify-center mr-3">
                                <span className="text-blue-600 font-semibold text-sm">
                                  {student.firstName[0]}{student.lastName[0]}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                <div className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
                                  {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                                </div>
                                {student.recentAbsences > 3 && (
                                  <div className="text-xs text-red-600">
                                    {student.recentAbsences} recent absences
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm text-gray-500">
                            {student.gender}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                            <span className={`text-sm font-semibold ${getPerformanceColor(student.attendancePercentage, 'attendance')}`}>
                              {student.attendancePercentage}%
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                            <span className={`text-sm font-semibold ${getPerformanceColor(student.averageGrade, 'grade')}`}>
                              {student.averageGrade}%
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                            <Badge variant={getStatusBadgeVariant(student.status)}>
                              {student.status}
                            </Badge>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                            <div className="text-sm text-gray-900">{student.guardianName}</div>
                            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{student.guardianPhone}</div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-sm">
                            <div className="flex space-x-2">
                              <button
                                className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-900"
                                title="View Details"
                              >
                                View
                              </button>
                              <button
                                className="text-green-600 hover:text-green-900"
                                title="Contact Guardian"
                              >
                                Contact
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                {/* Mobile Card View */}
                <div className="md:hidden space-y-4">
                  {filteredStudents.map((student) => (
                    <Card key={student.id} className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center">
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-100 flex items-center justify-center mr-3">
                            <span className="text-blue-600 font-semibold">
                              {student.firstName[0]}{student.lastName[0]}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
                              {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">{student.admissionNumber}</div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <Badge variant={getStatusBadgeVariant(student.status)}>
                          {student.status}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Attendance</div>
                          <div className={`font-semibold ${getPerformanceColor(student.attendancePercentage, 'attendance')}`}>
                            {student.attendancePercentage}%
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Avg. Grade</div>
                          <div className={`font-semibold ${getPerformanceColor(student.averageGrade, 'grade')}`}>
                            {student.averageGrade}%
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Gender</div>
                          <div className="text-sm text-gray-900">{student.gender}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Guardian</div>
                          <div className="text-sm text-gray-900">{student.guardianName}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {student.recentAbsences > 3 && (
                        <Alert variant="warning" className="mb-3 text-xs">
                          {student.recentAbsences} recent absences
                        </Alert>
                      )}

                      <div className="flex space-x-2">
                        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="flex-1">
                          View Details
                        </Button>
                        <Button size="sm" variant="primary" className="flex-1">
                          Contact
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {/* Quick Actions */}
            <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-gray-200">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <Button variant="primary">
                  <span className="mr-2">📊</span>
                  Class Report
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline">
                  <span className="mr-2">📝</span>
                  Mark Attendance
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline">
                  <span className="mr-2">📚</span>
                  Enter Grades
                </Button>
                <Button variant="outline">
                  <span className="mr-2">📧</span>
                  Send Message
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardHeader, CardContent, Badge, LoadingSpinner, Alert } from '@/components/ui';
import { format } from 'date-fns';

interface TeacherClass {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  stream: string;
  studentCount: number;
  subject?: string;
}

interface TodaySchedule {
  id: string;
  period: number;
  startTime: string;
  endTime: string;
  subject: string;
  class: string;
  room: string;
}

interface PendingTask {
  id: string;
  type: 'GRADE_ENTRY' | 'ATTENDANCE' | 'REPORT';
  title: string;
  dueDate: string;
  class: string;
}

export default function TeacherDashboardPage() {
  const [classes, setClasses] = useState<TeacherClass[]>([]);
  const [schedule, setSchedule] = useState<TodaySchedule[]>([]);
  const [pendingTasks, setPendingTasks] = useState<PendingTask[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboardData();
  }, []);

  const loadDashboardData = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      // Mock data - replace with actual API calls
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));

      setClasses([
        { id: '1', name: 'Grade 5', stream: 'A', studentCount: 32, subject: 'Mathematics' },
        { id: '2', name: 'Grade 5', stream: 'B', studentCount: 30, subject: 'Mathematics' },
        { id: '3', name: 'Grade 6', stream: 'A', studentCount: 28, subject: 'Mathematics' },
      ]);

      setSchedule([
        { id: '1', period: 1, startTime: '08:00', endTime: '08:45', subject: 'Mathematics', class: 'Grade 5A', room: 'Room 101' },
        { id: '2', period: 3, startTime: '10:00', endTime: '10:45', subject: 'Mathematics', class: 'Grade 5B', room: 'Room 101' },
        { id: '3', period: 6, startTime: '13:00', endTime: '13:45', subject: 'Mathematics', class: 'Grade 6A', room: 'Room 102' },
      ]);

      setPendingTasks([
        { id: '1', type: 'GRADE_ENTRY', title: 'Mid-term exam grades', dueDate: '2024-01-25', class: 'Grade 5A' },
        { id: '2', type: 'ATTENDANCE', title: "Today's attendance", dueDate: '2024-01-20', class: 'All Classes' },
        { id: '3', type: 'REPORT', title: 'Term report comments', dueDate: '2024-01-30', class: 'Grade 5A' },
      ]);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load dashboard:', err);
      setError('Failed to load dashboard data');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <LoadingSpinner size="lg" message="Loading dashboard..." />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6">
      {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}

      {/* Welcome Section */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-700 rounded-2xl p-6 text-white">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">
          Good {getGreeting()}, Teacher!
        </h1>
        <p className="text-indigo-100">
          You have {schedule.length} classes today and {pendingTasks.length} pending tasks
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <StatCard
          label="My Classes"
          value={classes.length.toString()}
          icon="users"
          color="indigo"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Total Students"
          value={classes.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.studentCount, 0).toString()}
          icon="user-group"
          color="blue"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Today's Classes"
          value={schedule.length.toString()}
          icon="calendar"
          color="green"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Pending Tasks"
          value={pendingTasks.length.toString()}
          icon="clipboard"
          color="orange"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {/* Today's Schedule */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader
            title="Today's Schedule"
            subtitle={format(new Date(), 'EEEE, MMMM dd')}
          />
          <CardContent className="p-0">
            {schedule.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                {schedule.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.id} className="p-4 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 mb-1">
                          <Badge variant="info">Period {item.period}</Badge>
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
                            {item.startTime} - {item.endTime}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{item.subject}</p>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
                          {item.class} • {item.room}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <a
                        href={`/teacher/attendance?class=${item.class}`}
                        className="text-sm text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 font-medium"
                      >
                        Mark Attendance →
                      </a>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">
                No classes scheduled for today
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Pending Tasks */}
        <Card>
          <CardHeader title="Pending Tasks" subtitle="Things that need your attention" />
          <CardContent className="p-0">
            {pendingTasks.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                {pendingTasks.map((task) => (
                  <div key={task.id} className="p-4 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 mb-1">
                          <TaskBadge type={task.type} />
                        </div>
                        <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">{task.title}</p>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
                          {task.class} • Due {format(new Date(task.dueDate), 'MMM dd')}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <button className="text-sm text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 font-medium">
                        Complete →
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-8 text-center">
                <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 bg-green-100 rounded-full mb-3">
                  <svg className="w-6 h-6 text-green-600" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                    <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                  </svg>
                </div>
                <p className="text-gray-500">All caught up!</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* My Classes */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader
          title="My Classes"
          action={
            <a
              href="/teacher/classes"
              className="text-sm text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 font-medium"
            >
              View All
            </a>
          }
        />
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {classes.map((cls) => (
              <a
                key={cls.id}
                href={`/teacher/classes/${cls.id}`}
                className="block bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-semibold text-gray-900 text-lg">
                      {cls.name} {cls.stream}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{cls.subject}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-indigo-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                    <svg className="w-6 h-6 text-indigo-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 4.354a4 4 0 110 5.292M15 21H3v-1a6 6 0 0112 0v1zm0 0h6v-1a6 6 0 00-9-5.197M13 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z" />
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">
                    {cls.studentCount} students
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sm text-indigo-600 font-medium">
                    View class →
                  </span>
                </div>
              </a>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Quick Actions */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader title="Quick Actions" />
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <QuickAction
              href="/teacher/attendance"
              icon="check"
              label="Mark Attendance"
              color="green"
            />
            <QuickAction
              href="/teacher/grades"
              icon="edit"
              label="Enter Grades"
              color="blue"
            />
            <QuickAction
              href="/teacher/timetable"
              icon="calendar"
              label="View Schedule"
              color="purple"
            />
            <QuickAction
              href="/teacher/classes"
              icon="users"
              label="Manage Classes"
              color="orange"
            />
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  icon,
  color,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  icon: string;
  color: string;
}) {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    indigo: 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600',
    blue: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600',
    green: 'bg-green-50 text-green-600',
    orange: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600',
  };

  return (
    <Card padding="lg">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">{label}</p>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">{value}</p>
        </div>
        <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center ${colors[color]}`}>
          <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 4.354a4 4 0 110 5.292M15 21H3v-1a6 6 0 0112 0v1zm0 0h6v-1a6 6 0 00-9-5.197M13 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z" />
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

function TaskBadge({ type }: { type: string }) {
  const config: Record<string, { variant: 'danger' | 'warning' | 'info'; label: string }> = {
    GRADE_ENTRY: { variant: 'warning', label: 'Grade Entry' },
    ATTENDANCE: { variant: 'danger', label: 'Attendance' },
    REPORT: { variant: 'info', label: 'Report' },
  };

  const { variant, label } = config[type] || { variant: 'info', label: type };

  return <Badge variant={variant}>{label}</Badge>;
}

function QuickAction({
  href,
  icon,
  label,
  color,
}: {
  href: string;
  icon: string;
  label: string;
  color: string;
}) {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    green: 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 hover:bg-green-100',
    blue: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-100',
    purple: 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-100',
    orange: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-100',
  };

  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 rounded-xl transition-colors tap-area ${colors[color]}`}
    >
      <svg className="w-8 h-8 mb-2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
      </svg>
      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-center">{label}</span>
    </a>
  );
}

function getGreeting(): string {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour < 12) return 'Morning';
  if (hour < 18) return 'Afternoon';
  return 'Evening';
}

File: apps/web/src/app/teacher/grades/page.tsx

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardHeader, CardContent, Button, LoadingSpinner, Alert, Badge } from '@/components/ui';

interface Student {
  id: string;
  admissionNumber: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
}

interface GradeEntry {
  studentId: string;
  marks: number | null;
  grade?: string;
}

interface ClassInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  stream: string;
  subject: string;
  students: Student[];
}

interface Exam {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  term: string;
  maxMarks: number;
}

export default function TeacherGradesPage() {
  const [selectedClass, setSelectedClass] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedExam, setSelectedExam] = useState<string>('');
  const [classes, setClasses] = useState<ClassInfo[]>([]);
  const [exams, setExams] = useState<Exam[]>([]);
  const [students, setStudents] = useState<Student[]>([]);
  const [grades, setGrades] = useState<Record<string, GradeEntry>>({});
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedClass) {
      loadStudents();
    }
  }, [selectedClass]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));

      const mockClasses = [
        {
          id: '1',
          name: 'Grade 5',
          stream: 'A',
          subject: 'Mathematics',
          students: generateMockStudents(32, '5A'),
        },
        {
          id: '2',
          name: 'Grade 5',
          stream: 'B',
          subject: 'Mathematics',
          students: generateMockStudents(30, '5B'),
        },
      ];

      const mockExams = [
        { id: '1', name: 'Mid-Term Exam', term: 'Term 1 2024', maxMarks: 100 },
        { id: '2', name: 'End-Term Exam', term: 'Term 1 2024', maxMarks: 100 },
        { id: '3', name: 'CAT 1', term: 'Term 1 2024', maxMarks: 50 },
      ];

      setClasses(mockClasses);
      setExams(mockExams);
      
      if (mockClasses.length > 0) setSelectedClass(mockClasses[0].id);
      if (mockExams.length > 0) setSelectedExam(mockExams[0].id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError('Failed to load data');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadStudents = () => {
    const classInfo = classes.find((c) => c.id === selectedClass);
    if (!classInfo) return;

    setStudents(classInfo.students);

    // Initialize grade entries
    const initialGrades: Record<string, GradeEntry> = {};
    classInfo.students.forEach((student) => {
      initialGrades[student.id] = {
        studentId: student.id,
        marks: null,
      };
    });
    setGrades(initialGrades);
  };

  const handleMarksChange = (studentId: string, value: string) => {
    const marks = value === '' ? null : Number(value);
    const exam = exams.find((e) => e.id === selectedExam);
    
    if (marks !== null && exam && marks > exam.maxMarks) {
      return; // Don't allow marks greater than max
    }

    const grade = marks !== null ? calculateGrade(marks) : undefined;

    setGrades((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [studentId]: {
        studentId,
        marks,
        grade,
      },
    }));
  };

  const calculateGrade = (marks: number): string => {
    if (marks >= 80) return 'A';
    if (marks >= 70) return 'B';
    if (marks >= 60) return 'C';
    if (marks >= 50) return 'D';
    return 'E';
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');

    try {
      // Validate all entries
      const entries = Object.values(grades);
      const invalidEntries = entries.filter(
        (entry) => entry.marks === null || entry.marks < 0
      );

      if (invalidEntries.length > 0) {
        setError(`Please enter valid marks for all ${students.length} students`);
        setIsSaving(false);
        return;
      }

      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));

      console.log('Saving grades:', {
        classId: selectedClass,
        examId: selectedExam,
        grades: entries,
      });

      setSuccess(`Grades saved successfully for ${students.length} students!`);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccess(''), 3000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError('Failed to save grades. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleBulkEntry = () => {
    const input = prompt('Enter marks for all students (comma-separated):');
    if (!input) return;

    const marksArray = input.split(',').map((m) => m.trim());
    
    if (marksArray.length !== students.length) {
      alert(`Please enter exactly ${students.length} marks`);
      return;
    }

    const updated = { ...grades };
    students.forEach((student, index) => {
      const marks = Number(marksArray[index]);
      if (!isNaN(marks)) {
        updated[student.id] = {
          studentId: student.id,
          marks,
          grade: calculateGrade(marks),
        };
      }
    });

    setGrades(updated);
  };

  // Calculate stats
  const enteredCount = Object.values(grades).filter((g) => g.marks !== null).length;
  const avgMarks = Object.values(grades).reduce((sum, g) => sum + (g.marks || 0), 0) / (enteredCount || 1);
  const highestMarks = Math.max(...Object.values(grades).map((g) => g.marks || 0));

  const selectedClassInfo = classes.find((c) => c.id === selectedClass);
  const selectedExamInfo = exams.find((e) => e.id === selectedExam);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <LoadingSpinner size="lg" message="Loading..." />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Enter Grades</h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600 mt-1">Record student examination marks</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <Alert variant="danger">{error}</Alert>}
      {success && <Alert variant="success">{success}</Alert>}

      {/* Filters */}
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                Select Class
              </label>
              <select
                value={selectedClass}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedClass(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                {classes.map((cls) => (
                  <option key={cls.id} value={cls.id}>
                    {cls.name} {cls.stream} - {cls.subject}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                Select Exam
              </label>
              <select
                value={selectedExam}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedExam(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                {exams.map((exam) => (
                  <option key={exam.id} value={exam.id}>
                    {exam.name} ({exam.term})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                Actions
              </label>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={handleBulkEntry}
                fullWidth
              >
                Bulk Entry
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <Card padding="lg">
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Entered</p>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
            {enteredCount}/{students.length}
          </p>
        </Card>
        <Card padding="lg">
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Average</p>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-indigo-600">
            {avgMarks.toFixed(1)}%
          </p>
        </Card>
        <Card padding="lg">
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Highest</p>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-600">{highestMarks}%</p>
        </Card>
        <Card padding="lg">
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Max Marks</p>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
            {selectedExamInfo?.maxMarks || 0}
          </p>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Grade Entry Table */}
      {selectedClassInfo && selectedExamInfo && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader
            title={`${selectedClassInfo.name} ${selectedClassInfo.stream} - ${selectedClassInfo.subject}`}
            subtitle={`${selectedExamInfo.name} (Max: ${selectedExamInfo.maxMarks} marks)`}
          />
          <CardContent className="p-0">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full">
                <thead className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                      #
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                      Admission No.
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                      Student Name
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                      Marks (out of {selectedExamInfo.maxMarks})
                    </th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">
                      Grade
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {students.map((student, index) => (
                    <tr key={student.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-gray-500">{index + 1}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
                        {student.admissionNumber}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-indigo-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                            <span className="text-indigo-700 font-medium text-sm">
                              {student.firstName.charAt(0)}
                              {student.lastName.charAt(0)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
                            {student.firstName} {student.lastName}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          min="0"
                          max={selectedExamInfo.maxMarks}
                          value={grades[student.id]?.marks ?? ''}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            handleMarksChange(student.id, e.target.value)
                          }
                          className="w-24 px-3 py-2 text-center border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                          placeholder="0"
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        {grades[student.id]?.grade ? (
                          <GradeBadge grade={grades[student.id].grade!} />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-gray-400 text-sm">-</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Save Button */}
      {students.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex justify-end space-x-3">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={loadStudents}>
            Reset
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={handleSave} isLoading={isSaving}>
            {isSaving
              ? 'Saving...'
              : `Save Grades (${enteredCount}/${students.length})`}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function GradeBadge({ grade }: { grade: string }) {
  const variants: Record<string, 'success' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger'> = {
    A: 'success',
    B: 'info',
    C: 'warning',
    D: 'warning',
    E: 'danger',
  };

  return (
    <Badge variant={variants[grade] || 'default'} size="sm">
      {grade}
    </Badge>
  );
}

function generateMockStudents(count: number, classCode: string): Student[] {
  const firstNames = [
    'John',
    'Mary',
    'Peter',
    'Jane',
    'David',
    'Sarah',
    'Michael',
    'Emily',
  ];
  const lastNames = [
    'Smith',
    'Johnson',
    'Kamau',
    'Wanjiku',
    'Ochieng',
    'Akinyi',
  ];

  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `${classCode}-${i + 1}`,
    admissionNumber: `ADM-2024-${classCode}-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
    firstName: firstNames[i % firstNames.length],
    lastName: lastNames[i % lastNames.length],
  }));
}

'use client';

import { useState, FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { api } from '@/lib/api-client';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function TeacherLoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await api.login(email, password);
      
      // Verify user is a teacher
      if (!['TEACHER', 'CLASS_TEACHER', 'EXAMINATION_OFFICER'].includes(response.user.role)) {
        setError('This portal is for teachers only. Please use the correct login portal.');
        setIsLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      
      // Store tokens
      localStorage.setItem('accessToken', response.accessToken);
      localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', response.refreshToken);
      
      // Store user info
      localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(response.user));

      // Redirect to teacher dashboard
      router.push('/teacher/dashboard');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Login error:', err);
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.message || 
        'Invalid email or password. Please try again.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-indigo-100 px-4 py-12">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        {/* Logo and Title */}

            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"

              />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-2">
            Krypton School ERP
          </h1>
          <p className="text-gray-600">Teacher Portal Login</p>
